title: Disneyland Paris Walking Tour 🇫🇷 | Sleeping Beauty Castle, Rides & Park Atmosphere (4K)
description: Experience the magic of *Disneyland Paris* on this immersive 4K walking tour through the park’s iconic lands, attractions, and themed environments. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - September 2021 - 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶141min)
description: Rome is my favorite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Evening Walk - September 2021 - 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶103min)
description: Rome is my favourite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

If you appear in this video and wish to have your image removed, please contact me. Information: Join us for a festive day walk through the world-famous Christmas Markets of Nuremberg, Germany. Starting at Fleischbrücke Bridge, this immersive tour covers a variety of markets, including the bustling Hauptmarkt, the charming Sister Cities Market, and the enchanting Children’s Market. History: The Nuremberg Christmas Market, or Christkindlesmarkt, dates back to the early 17th century and is one of the oldest and most traditional Christmas markets in Germany. Held in the city's historic Hauptmarkt square, it draws visitors from all over the world to experience its handcrafted ornaments, delicious seasonal treats, and festive spirit. Highlights of this tour include the Schöner Brunnen (24:10), a Gothic-style fountain adorned with intricate figures, and the grand St. Sebaldus Church (26:36), one of Nuremberg’s oldest churches, dating back to the 13th century. Additionally, the Handwerkerhof (1:03:16) showcases traditional craftsmanship, offering a glimpse into Nuremberg’s artisan history. Tourist Tips: Start your walk at Fleischbrücke Bridge (1:06) for scenic views of Nuremberg’s Old Town. Wander through the heart of the Hauptmarkt Christmas Market (3:21 and 34:59) to sample local specialties like gingerbread and mulled wine. Visit the Children’s Market (39:58) at Hans-Sachs-Platz for family-friendly activities and handcrafted toys. Take a moment to admire the architectural beauty of St. Sebaldus Church (26:36) and the Church of St. Lorenz (54:04), two of the city's most iconic churches. Don’t miss the Ehekarussell Fountain (1:23:11), a quirky and artistic depiction of the ups and downs of marriage. End your walk with picturesque views from Hangman’s Bridge (1:34:42) and Maxbrücke Bridge (1:35:32), perfect for capturing the beauty of Nuremberg’s medieval charm. #ProwalkTours #Walkingtour #Nuremberg #ChristmasMarkets

title: Herculaneum, Italy Walking Tour in 4K
description: This walk was filmed on January 6th, 2018. On August 24th, 79 AD, Mt. Vesuvius erupted for the first time in centuries. Herculaneum, just 3 miles away from the base of Mt. Vesuvius was spared from initial destruction as the wind carried most of the ash and pumice on to Pompeii. On the following night, the plume of ash above Mt. Vesuvius collapsed causing massive pyroclastic flows that buried both Pompeii and Herculaneum. While most of Pompeii has been excavated. It is estimated that only 25% of Herculaneum has been excavated. title: BERLIN - Germany 🇩🇪 4K Walking Tour | Iphone 15 Pro 📹 Berlin is getting cold and windy 🥶
description: This walking video was recorded in 4k in Berlin, the capital of Germany 🇩🇪 Berlin is the capital and a state of the Federal Republic of Germany. With about 3.7 million inhabitants, the city is the most populous and, with 892 square kilometers, the largest municipality in Germany, as well as the most populous city in the European Union. The city has the third highest population density in Germany with 4108 inhabitants per square kilometer. Nearly 4.7 million inhabitants live in the Berlin agglomeration, and about 6.2 million in the Berlin-Brandenburg capital region. Berlin is considered a world city of culture, politics, media and science. The local universities and research institutions, local sports and museums enjoy an international reputation. The metropolis holds the UNESCO title of City of Design and is one of the continent's most visited centers. Its architecture, festivities and nightlife are world-renowned. After the end of World War II, the city was subject to a four-power status in 1945; East Berlin functioned as the capital of the socialist German Democratic Republic from 1949, while West Berlin was closely aligned with the liberal-democratic Federal Republic. With the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 and German reunification in 1990, the two halves of the city grew together again and Berlin regained its role as the all-German capital. Since 1999, the city has been the seat of the Federal Government, the Federal President, the German Bundestag, the Bundesrat, as well as most federal ministries, numerous federal agencies and embassies. ------------------------------ Germany Playlist 🇩🇪 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaCCxt8X-lBy7GBAYeOuiwOs9vpc_XnMn Switzerland Playlist 🇨🇭 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaCCxt8X-lBzdzbVXqVNlA5z8w2XnHrpE Türkiye Playlist 🇹🇷 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaCCxt8X-lByRbEwoMf6MosDPo4TxGei5 Dubai Playlist 🇦🇪 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaCCxt8X-lBz_Dtbs5_b9A3zzr7vyZZDL ------------------------------ 0:00 Potsdamer Platz 6:00 Sony Center 12:09 Ebertstraße 17:58 Memorial Jews of Europe | Denkmal für die Juden Europas 14:39 Brandenburg Gate | Brandenburger Tor 27:45 Unter den Linden 41:55 Friedrichstraße 🙌 Support with a donation! https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/MediaOZ 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. Information: Join me for a magical evening walk through the Nuremberg Christmas Market (Christkindlesmarkt), one of the oldest and most beloved holiday markets in the world. This festive tour covers the beautifully lit stalls, cozy holiday atmosphere, and charming historic sites of Nuremberg during the Christmas season. From the bustling Hauptmarkt to the quaint Children’s Market, this evening walk captures the true spirit of Christmas in Germany. History: The Nuremberg Christkindlesmarkt dates back to the early 17th century and remains one of the most traditional Christmas markets in Germany. Located in the city’s Hauptmarkt (3:54), the market is a festive gathering place filled with handcrafted ornaments, seasonal treats like gingerbread, and twinkling lights. The tour also highlights important historical landmarks like the Schöner Brunnen (23:49), a Gothic fountain dating back to the 14th century, and the St. Sebaldus Church (27:12), one of Nuremberg’s oldest churches. At the Craftmen’s Courtyard (1:09:42), you'll discover traditional craftsmanship, showcasing Nuremberg’s artisan heritage. Take your time in the Children’s Market (47:00), perfect for families with its rides, toys, and holiday activities for kids. title: Venice, Italy 🇮🇹 | July 2022 - 4K/60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Venice is one of the world's most beautiful cities. It is made up of over a hundred islands in a lagoon in the northern Adriatic Sea. Venice is a cultural and tourist destination known for its museums, architecture, cityscape, and art world. Only around one-fourth of Venice's 280 000 inhabitants live in the city's historical center. The remainder reside on the mainland. Boats that travel up and down the city's many canals are the primary mode of transportation between the islands. The Canale Grande, which runs through the heart of Venice, is the main waterway. The islands are linked by hundreds of bridges. Motorboats have largely replaced the historic gondolas, which are now only used for sightseeing tours. People either walk or take so-called waterbuses to get around the islands. The Piazza San Marco, also known as Saint Mark's Square, is the heart of Venice. The piazza's main attractions are the city's most famous church, San Marco Basilica, and the Doge's Palace, which served as the residence of Venice's rulers for hundreds of years. The square is a popular tourist destination that is surrounded by cafes and vendors. Lido, a 10-kilometer-long sandy island east of the historic center on the lagoon's rim, attracts thousands of beachgoers during the summer months. The Venice Film Festival is one of the city's major annual film events. Venice has faced numerous challenges as a result of its sea-level location and global warming. The Mediterranean town has been regularly flooded by incoming tides over the centuries. From November to February, they cause acqua alta, which causes sea levels to rise up to 1.5 meters and cover many of Venice's famous areas. To provide pedestrians with a path to walk, wooden walkways must be built. Many buildings' foundations have been damaged by seawater, necessitating ongoing repairs. Water seeps into the buildings, destroying the walls and the priceless frescoes. Industries and tourism have steadily reduced ground water levels in Venice, making building foundations unstable. The islands are sinking at an alarming rate of 3 to 4 mm per year. City planners are working on building a series of steel gates that will hopefully prevent seawater from entering the lagoon. title: Egyptian Museum 2nd Floor Walking Tour - Tutankhamun Exhibit!
description: See the Tutankhamen exhibit in this next installment of the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. The outer halls of the 2nd floor contain the treasures of Yuya and Tuya, the great-grandparents of Tutankhamun. The treasure of Tutankhamun is also on display in the outer hall. The rooms along each hall contain artifacts according to different themes. Video and pictures are not allowed inside the room that contains the funerary mask of King Tut. title: Ibiza, Spain 🇪🇸 - SUMMER PARADISE 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶195min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Ibiza, the ultimate paradise for those seeking sun-soaked beaches, vibrant nightlife, and a unique blend of relaxation and excitement. Situated in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of Spain, Ibiza is renowned worldwide for its electrifying energy and stunning natural beauty. In this captivating destination, you'll discover pristine white sand beaches caressed by turquoise waters, where you can unwind and soak up the Mediterranean sun. Explore the famous Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Comte, or Talamanca, each offering a distinct atmosphere and breathtaking coastal vistas. Immerse yourself in the vibrant beach club scene, where world-class DJs spin their tunes and create an atmosphere of pure euphoria. But Ibiza is not just about its picturesque coastline; it also boasts a rich cultural heritage. Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Dalt Vila, the fortified old town of Ibiza, where narrow cobblestone streets wind through medieval architecture. Explore the ancient walls, visit the stunning cathedral, and savor the enchanting views overlooking the island and the shimmering Mediterranean Sea. As the sun sets, Ibiza transforms into a legendary nightlife destination. Experience the pulsating beats and energetic atmosphere of world-famous clubs like Pacha, Amnesia, or Ushuaïa. Dance the night away to the music of internationally acclaimed DJs, creating memories that will last a lifetime. Ibiza also offers a variety of culinary delights to satisfy every palate. From fresh seafood dishes to traditional Spanish tapas and international cuisine, the island's diverse dining scene ensures a culinary adventure like no other. Whether you're seeking relaxation, thrilling adventures, or unforgettable parties, Ibiza has it all. With its stunning natural landscapes, vibrant nightlife, and rich cultural heritage, Ibiza is truly a destination that encapsulates the essence of a dream vacation. Get ready to immerse yourself in the magic of Ibiza and create memories that will stay with you forever. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Santorini, Greece 🇬🇷 - Day & Night 4K Walking Tour (▶223min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Santorini is a captivating Greek island nestled in the southern Aegean Sea, renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, charming architecture, and rich history. Formed by a volcanic caldera, the island boasts dramatic cliffs that plunge into the azure waters of the Aegean, creating a picture-perfect backdrop that has made Santorini a favorite among travelers and photographers. The iconic architecture of Santorini is characterized by whitewashed buildings with blue-domed roofs, creating a striking contrast against the deep blue sky and sea. The narrow, winding streets of its main towns, such as Fira and Oia, are lined with charming cafes, boutiques, and traditional Greek tavernas, offering visitors a delightful blend of modern amenities and authentic island life. Santorini's history is as fascinating as its scenery. The island is often associated with the ancient Minoan civilization and the legend of the lost city of Atlantis. Visitors can explore archaeological sites like Akrotiri, a well-preserved ancient city that was preserved in volcanic ash, offering a glimpse into the island's past. The island is renowned for its stunning sunsets, particularly in the village of Oia, where crowds gather every evening to witness the sun dip below the horizon, casting a warm glow over the whitewashed buildings and creating a magical atmosphere. For those seeking relaxation, Santorini offers beautiful beaches with unique volcanic sand, such as the Red Beach and Perissa Beach. The therapeutic hot springs at Palea Kameni, another result of the island's volcanic activity, provide a rejuvenating experience amidst the picturesque surroundings. Whether you're drawn to its captivating history, charming architecture, or mesmerizing landscapes, Santorini stands as a timeless destination that captures the hearts of all who visit, leaving an indelible imprint of its beauty and allure. If you appear in this video and wish to have your image removed, please contact me. History: Capri has been a destination of choice for Roman emperors, artists, and writers throughout history. This island, with its dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters, has been a symbol of luxury and natural beauty since the time of Emperor Tiberius, who once made Capri his private retreat. The island’s iconic Piazzetta, once a marketplace, has become the social heart of Capri, while the ancient Carthusia Perfume Shops continue a centuries-old tradition of creating fragrances inspired by the island's flora. From the Roman ruins at the Gardens of Augustus to the natural wonder of the Arco Naturale, this tour delves into the island’s rich cultural and historical heritage. Tourist Tips: Start at Marina Grande (timestamp 1:04) to soak in the island’s vibrant port and stunning coastline. Don’t miss the lively Piazzetta of Capri (25:45), known as the “Living Room of the World,” where you can relax and enjoy a coffee. Visit the luxurious Hotel Quisisana (55:03), a Capri landmark where many celebrities have stayed. Explore the fragrant world of Capri’s famous Carthusia Perfume Shops (timestamps 1:00:51 and 1:18:32) and discover the island’s floral-inspired scents. Stroll through the breathtaking Gardens of Augustus (1:22:45) for panoramic views of the Faraglioni rock formations. End your tour at the scenic Belvedere di Punta Cannone (3:54:21) for spectacular views over Capri’s coastline. title: Malaga, Spain 🇪🇸 July 2023 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶188min)
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Malaga, a vibrant coastal city nestled on Spain's stunning Costa del Sol. With its rich history, vibrant culture, and Mediterranean charm, Malaga offers a captivating blend of old-world elegance and modern delights. As you explore the city, you'll be greeted by a captivating mix of architectural wonders. Marvel at the imposing Alcazaba, a Moorish fortress that dates back to the 11th century, and its neighboring Roman Theatre, a testament to the city's ancient past. Discover the stunning Malaga Cathedral, known as "La Manquita" (the one-armed lady) due to its unfinished south tower, and admire its intricate Renaissance and Baroque design. Wander through the narrow streets of the historic center, known as the Casco Antiguo, where you'll find charming plazas, bustling markets, and delightful tapas bars. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of Plaza de la Merced, the birthplace of renowned artist Pablo Picasso. Explore the Picasso Museum, housed in a beautiful 16th-century palace, and discover the fascinating works that chronicle the artist's life and artistic evolution. Malaga is also blessed with picturesque beaches that line its coastline. Enjoy the golden sands and azure waters of Malagueta Beach, where you can relax under the warm Mediterranean sun or take a refreshing dip in the sea. Alternatively, venture further along the coast to discover hidden coves and quieter stretches of shoreline, where you can escape the crowds and embrace a tranquil beach experience. Indulge in the culinary delights of Malaga by sampling traditional Andalusian cuisine. Savor fresh seafood, such as the famous Malaga fried fish or succulent grilled sardines, paired with a glass of local Malaga wine. Explore the lively food markets, such as Mercado Central de Atarazanas, where you can discover an array of fresh produce, regional specialties, and delightful tapas. Malaga's cultural scene is thriving, with a variety of museums and galleries to explore. Visit the Contemporary Art Center (CAC) to experience thought-provoking exhibitions, or venture to the Centre Pompidou Malaga, a vibrant space showcasing contemporary art from the renowned Parisian museum. Discover the innovative Muelle Uno, a modern waterfront development with trendy shops, restaurants, and stunning views of the harbor. As the sun sets, Malaga comes alive with a vibrant nightlife scene. Explore the lively bars and clubs in the city center, where you can dance the night away to a mix of international and Spanish music, or simply unwind with a cocktail and soak in the energetic atmosphere. With its captivating history, cultural treasures, beautiful beaches, and warm hospitality, Malaga offers a truly unforgettable experience. Whether you're exploring the city's rich heritage, enjoying a leisurely beach day, or indulging in its vibrant culinary and nightlife scene, Malaga invites you to embrace its unique blend of Mediterranean charm and Andalusian allure. This video was captured at 12 Of July 2023. description: Naples, known as Napoli in Italian, is a vibrant and dynamic city located in the southern part of Italy. As the capital of the Campania region, it is one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, with a rich history stretching back to the second millennium BC. Renowned for its picturesque coastline, historic architecture, and cultural treasures, Naples offers a unique blend of ancient history and modern charm. 0:00:00 Intro The heart of Naples is its historic city center, a UNESCO World Heritage site, characterized by a labyrinth of narrow, winding streets. This area is dotted with ancient churches, grand palaces, and bustling markets. Among these historical landmarks is the Naples Cathedral, also known as the Cathedral of San Gennaro, which houses the relics of the city's patron saint. 0:04:44 Naples Porto District Naples is also famous for its proximity to Mount Vesuvius, the still-active volcano that famously erupted in AD 79, burying the nearby cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum. These archaeological sites provide a fascinating glimpse into ancient Roman life and are among the most visited attractions in Italy. 1:00:00 Centro Historico Culinary delights are a significant part of Naples' allure. The city is the birthplace of pizza, with traditional Neapolitan pizza being a must-try. The local cuisine also features a variety of seafood dishes, pasta, and pastries, with sfogliatella and babà being popular local treats. 1:35:00 Naples Signature Alleys Naples' vibrant street life, lively piazzas, and rich artistic heritage contribute to its unique atmosphere. The city is home to several important museums and art galleries, such as the Naples National Archaeological Museum, which houses one of the most extensive collections of Greco-Roman artifacts in the world, and the Capodimonte Museum, renowned for its impressive collection of Renaissance and Baroque art. 2:07:45 Live Napolitanian Street Music Despite its chaotic traffic and some areas of urban decay, Naples exudes immense charm and character. The city's warm climate, friendly locals, and vibrant festivals make it a captivating destination for travelers seeking an authentic Italian experience. Its blend of ancient history, stunning landscapes, and lively cultural scene offers visitors a truly unforgettable journey through one of Italy's most enchanting cities. 2:21:19 Naples Centro ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and I will make sure that you are not on this video anymore.***

title: Edinburgh, Scotland 🇬🇧 — Old Town to Castle Walk | 4K HDR 60fps
description: There’s something about Edinburgh that gets under your skin and refuses to leave. Maybe it’s the way the ancient stone seems to trap the last rays of sunlight… or how the narrow streets feel haunted by centuries of footsteps. This city doesn’t just speak — it possesses you, one quiet moment at a time. On this walk, I surrendered to Edinburgh’s pull — through the twisting veins of the Old Town, beneath the looming shadow of the castle, and into hidden corners most eyes will never see. No map. title: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - Ipanema Sunny Beach Walking Tour -4K60fps with Captions - Prowalk Tours
description: Ipanema Beach walking tour through Rio de Janeiro's most celebrated beachfront — from Leblon Beach, across Ipanema, to the Tom Jobim statue and Pedra do Arpoador for the sunset. A walk along the 2.6 km beach that inspired Antônio Carlos Jobim and Vinícius de Moraes to write "The Girl from Ipanema" in 1962. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio. In the early 1960s, Jobim and de Moraes watched Helô Pinheiro walk to the beach past the Veloso bar on Rua Montenegro in Ipanema. The song they wrote about her — "Garota de Ipanema" — became the second most-recorded song in the world and launched bossa nova globally. The bar is now called Garota de Ipanema, and the Tom Jobim statue stands on the Arpoador boardwalk, at the end of the beach visited at 1:02:05. Every evening, crowds gather on Pedra do Arpoador to watch the sunset, applauding as the sun drops behind the Dois Irmãos mountains at the far end of Leblon. Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones. ⭐ Don't miss: Mirante do Leblon viewpoint at 0:40, the Tom Jobim statue at 1:02:05, Pedra do Arpoador at 1:15:28, and the sunset at 1:23:31. 📅 Filmed on: Monday, January 29th, 2024 at 4:06 PM 📍 Location: Ipanema & Leblon, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1MfJ8rPJb2wKWz2poVViA-nxY6qDA1BQ&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Drone Intro and Map ⭐ 0:40 Mirante do Leblon (Viewpoint) 5:03 Leblon Beach 32:00 Ipanema Beach 56:35 Arpoador Beach ⭐ 1:02:05 Tom Jobim Statue 1:09:07 Largo do Millôr ⭐ 1:15:28 Pedra do Arpoador ⭐ 1:23:31 Watching the Sunset 1:37:38 Sunset Walk on Boardwalk ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎶 ABOUT IPANEMA ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Ipanema sits between Leblon and Copacabana in the South Zone (Zona Sul) of Rio de Janeiro, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean and the Lagoa Rodrigo de Freitas lagoon. The beach is divided into sections marked by numbered lifeguard stations (postos) — each with its own distinct culture and crowd. Antônio Carlos Jobim (1927–1994), known as Tom Jobim, was one of the founders of bossa nova and is considered one of the most important figures in Brazilian music. His statue on the Arpoador boardwalk honors the composer who, along with his frequent collaborator Vinícius de Moraes, gave Ipanema its place in the musical imagination of the 20th century. title: DOHA, Qatar 🇶🇦 4K Driving Tour Downtown, Lusail & The Pearl
description: Doha, Qatar's capital and financial center, is a captivating blend of modern skyscrapers and traditional charm. Nestled on the Persian Gulf coast, Doha is Qatar's fastest-growing city, with a vibrant atmosphere and a population exceeding 800,000. Founded in the 1820s, Doha has blossomed into a prominent figure in the Middle East. Officially designated as Qatar's capital upon gaining independence in 1971, Doha has become a beta-level global city, attracting international recognition for its commerce and emerging financial sector. Doha is a hub for innovation, housing Education City, a dedicated research and education zone, and Hamad Medical City, a renowned center for healthcare. Sports enthusiasts will find Doha a haven, with Aspire Zone, an international sports destination featuring world-class facilities like Khalifa International Stadium and the Aspire Dome. Doha has positioned itself as a major player on the world stage. The city hosted the first ministerial meeting of the World Trade Organization's Doha Development Round, solidifying its role in global trade discussions. Doha's commitment to sporting excellence is evident, having hosted prestigious events like the 2006 Asian Games, the 2022 FIFA World Cup, and the upcoming 2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup. Safety is a top priority in Doha. The city has been ranked as the second safest in the world according to the Numbeo Crime Index by City 2021, providing peace of mind for visitors and residents alike. Doha offers a captivating blend of cultural heritage, modern marvels, and a commitment to progress. title: Matera, Italy Walking Tour [4K | 60fps]
description: Matera walking tour through the Sassi di Matera — the ancient cave-dwelling districts carved into the limestone cliffs of southern Italy. A walk through Sasso Barisano, Sasso Caveoso, and the Civita in Matera, Italy, including the Palombaro Lungo underground cistern, the 13th-century Matera Cathedral, rock churches, and a cave house open to visitors. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio. The Sassi of Matera and the Murgia Materana Park were inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1993, and Matera is believed to be the third oldest continuously inhabited city in the world, after Jericho and Aleppo. This walk was filmed on June 28, 2019 — four days before Matera's biggest celebration of the year, Festa della Bruna, and during the year Matera served as European Capital of Culture. The city has appeared as a filming location for Mel Gibson's The Passion of the Christ (2004), the opening sequence of No Time to Die (2021), Wonder Woman (2017), and Ben-Hur (2016). Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones. ⭐ Don't miss: Palombaro Lungo underground cistern at 2:59, Belvedere Luigi Guerricchio viewpoint at 3:55, Piazza Duomo at 42:11, Casa Grotta di Vico Solitario (inside a cave house) at 1:03:45, Santa Maria de Idris rock church at 1:12:42, and Necropoli di Santa Lucia alle Malve at 1:20:04. 📅 Filmed on: Friday, June 28th, 2019 at 12:18 PM 📍 Location: Matera, Basilicata, Italy ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Drone Intro 1:47 Piazza Vittorio Veneto ⭐ 2:59 Palombaro Lungo (Underground Cistern) ⭐ 3:55 Belvedere Luigi Guerricchio (Sassi Viewpoint) 7:01 Steps Down into Sasso Barisano 15:09 The Sassi in Miniature 21:05 Convent of Saint Agostino 25:45 View of Chiesa Rupestre di San Giuliano 31:01 Palazzo del Casale ⭐ 42:11 Piazza Duomo 46:11 Piazza del Sedile 47:14 Palazzo del Sedile 49:09 Church of Purgatory (Via Ridola) 50:29 Church of Saint Clare 52:10 Piazzetta Giovanni Pascoli 52:43 Terrace Viewpoint of the Sassi 53:28 Path Down to the Sasso Caveoso ⭐ 1:03:45 Inside a Sassi Cave House (Casa Grotta di Vico Solitario) 1:06:24 Piazza San Pietro Caveoso 1:07:08 Church of Saint Peter ⭐ 1:12:42 Church of Santa Maria de Idris (Rock Church) ⭐ 1:20:04 Necropoli di Santa Lucia alle Malve ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⛪ ABOUT MATERA ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Matera is built on a rocky outcrop in the Basilicata region of southern Italy and has been continuously inhabited for roughly 9,000 years. The Sassi — two districts of cave dwellings carved into the soft tuff limestone — were home to thousands of residents living without running water or electricity until the 1950s, when the Italian government forcibly relocated them in what became known as "the shame of Italy." Matera has since been restored, becoming a UNESCO site in 1993 and European Capital of Culture in 2019. The Palombaro Lungo, visited at 2:59, is a vast hand-carved underground cistern beneath Piazza Vittorio Veneto — 15 meters deep with a capacity of 5 million liters — that served as the city's primary water reserve until 1920 and was only rediscovered in 1991. ▶ Watch Next: https://www.youtube.com/@ProwalkTours ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📽 MORE WALKING TOURS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🍕 Italy: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCc6k7EuMhr764qCNeXDrxpj&si=aYfLAtNw1eGc560w 🎄 Christmas Markets: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCd2nqHyPaDtgxkf_BsAuQCt&si=0YU1zhv0tLbwm8u6 🌍 Complete List: http://www.prowalks.com/videos ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📢 SUPPORT & CONNECT 📢 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌍 Website: https://www.prowalktours.com 📧 Email: info@prowalktours.com 🔔 Subscribe for more! https://www.youtube.com/@ProwalkTours 🟥 Become a Member: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNzul4dnciIlDg8BAcn5-cQ/join 🔶 Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Prowalktours 🔷 Help with a donation: https://www.paypal.me/Prowalks ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎥 CAMERA & RECORDING GEAR I USE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📱 Beginner / Ultra Portable: DJI Osmo Pocket 3 👉 https://amzn.to/4aelKS2 🎬 Professional Cinematic: Sony A7S III 👉 https://amzn.to/4qga72E 🔭 Main Lens: Sony FE PZ 16-35mm F4 G 👉 https://amzn.to/4kiAPX3 🎥 Gimbal: DJI RS4 Mini 👉 https://amzn.to/4bCxMXM 🎙️ Microphone: Sony ECM-M1 👉 https://amzn.to/3ZQ75HH ⭐ Essential Accessories 💾 Memory Cards 👉 https://amzn.to/4tnYeuE 🔋 Extra Batteries 👉 https://amzn.to/46uvFBC 🧿 ND Filter 👉 https://amzn.to/46r3RxZ 🧳 Comfortable Walking Shoes 👉 https://amzn.to/45ORf3G 🛒 Complete Gear List: https://www.amazon.com/shop/prowalktours 🚷 No portion of this video may be used without prior written consent from Prowalk Tours. title: Edinburgh — An Edinburger’s Walk Through Scotland’s Most Beautiful City
description: There’s something about Edinburgh that gets under your skin and refuses to leave. Maybe it’s the way the ancient stone seems to trap the last rays of sunlight… or how the narrow streets feel haunted by centuries of footsteps. This city doesn’t just speak — it possesses you, one quiet moment at a time. On this walk, I surrendered to Edinburgh’s pull — through the twisting veins of the Old Town, beneath the looming shadow of the castle, and into hidden corners most eyes will never see. No map. No plan. Just me, caught in the spell of a city that feels immortal. Walk with me — but don’t be surprised if part of you never comes back. ***Friendly Note: Hi there! title: Glasgow Scotland UK | Walking City Tour 4K
description: First Person point of view at one of the best cities in Europe. Glasgow is back. Once the second city of the British Empire, when its shipping, industry and commerce circled the globe, it has reinvented itself as a cultural powerhouse of music, creative arts, theatre, design and innovative cuisine. The transformation from a period of economic decline has been dramatic. It began in earnest in the 1980s, and by the end of the decade it had been proclaimed European City of Culture, followed by City of Architecture and Design, and Unesco City of Music – the first British city to win this accolade. The rusting shipyards faded into history, and in their place rose the striking futuristic architecture of award-winning museums and performance venues. It remains one of the most eclectic architectural cities in Europe, with a wealth of extravagant Victorian buildings in red and blond sandstone with artistic flourishes. Look out for Italianate palazzo frontages, Art Nouveau masterpieces reminiscent of Gaudi, classical Greek and Roman motifs, and the lavish Spanish Renaissance style of its Kelvingrove Art Gallery. Glasgow is a sociable city that has always known how to party. In the 1920s it had 81 ballrooms and dance halls, more than anywhere else in Britain, and thousands were still dancing to big bands in the famed Barrowland as German bombers roared overhead in the 1940s. The music scene today is more diverse and dynamic, with scores of pubs and clubs rocking to indie bands, cool jazz, fiery folk and Latin rhythms, and concert halls showcasing the classics. An average of more than 100 music events take place each week, with international headline acts staged in the city’s stunning new SSE Hydro arena. Scotland’s national orchestra, opera and ballet companies have all based themselves in Glasgow, and in 2019 the city was voted Europe's leading festival and events destination in the World Travel Awards. The city’s original Gaelic name, Glaschu, means ‘Green Place’ and it boasts one of the greatest arrays of public parks and woodland in Europe ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me at toyrister@gmail.com or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

Our 3-hour walking tour of Mykonos is the perfect way to explore this beautiful Greek island without ever leaving your home. From the winding streets of Mykonos Town to the pristine beaches and sparkling blue waters, we'll show you every inch of this glamorous destination in stunning 4K resolution. title: LONDON, England 🇬🇧 Europe’s Most Powerful Capital | 4K Walking Tour
description: Experience London’s most iconic landmark in this real-time 4K walking tour around Tower Bridge and the River Thames. One of the city’s most photographed spots, Tower Bridge combines historic architecture with stunning views of London’s modern skyline. We begin near the Tower of London, passing its medieval fortress walls, before walking onto Tower Bridge itself. From the bridge, you’ll see incredible views of the Shard, the City of London skyscrapers, and boats on the Thames. The walk continues along the South Bank, where the riverside promenade is filled with locals, street performers, and outdoor cafés. 🎥 Perfect for viewers searching for Tower Bridge walking tour, London 4K, Thames riverside walk, or virtual tours of London landmarks. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🏰 Tower of London – Medieval fortress and royal history 🌉 Tower Bridge – London’s most iconic bridge with Gothic towers 🏙️ The Shard & City skyline – Modern architecture framing the view 🚶 South Bank promenade – Riverside walk with cafés and life 🚢 River Thames – Boats and classic London scenery 📌 About Tower Bridge & the Thames: Opened in 1894, Tower Bridge is one of the most recognizable bridges in the world. Combining Victorian engineering with Gothic design, it remains a symbol of London. Together with the Tower of London and the South Bank, this area shows the perfect contrast between history and modern life in the UK capital. title: Venice Italy 🇮🇹 - Italy's Magical World - 4k HDR 60fps Walking Tour (▶234min)
description: Venice feels like a dream stitched together by stone bridges and silent canals. In this 4K walking tour we drift from grand piazzas to shadowy calli, past Gothic palazzi and artisan workshops, watching gondolas slide along the green ribbon of the Grand Canal. We step into St Mark’s Square at dawn, cross the Rialto’s arch, trace Titian and Tintoretto’s footsteps, and end where the sea breeze meets the lagoon—proof that Venice isn’t just a city, it’s a mood. Areas of Venice (the 6 Sestieri — Historic Center) San Marco – St Mark’s Basilica, Doge’s Palace, Piazza San Marco, La Fenice San Polo – Rialto Bridge & Market, San Giacomo di Rialto Dorsoduro – Accademia, Zattere promenade, Peggy Guggenheim, Giudecca & San Giorgio Maggiore (islands traditionally grouped with Dorsoduro) Santa Croce – Tolentini, Fondaco dei Turchi, gateways from Piazzale Roma Cannaregio – Jewish Ghetto, Strada Nova, quiet canals north of the Grand Canal Castello – Arsenale, Biennale Gardens, long waterside promenades Major Lagoon Islands & Districts (commonly visited) Murano (glassmaking islands) Burano (colorful fishermen’s houses) & Mazzorbo Torcello (ancient cathedral & mosaic) Lido di Venezia (beaches, Art Nouveau) Pellestrina (low-key fishing island) Sant’Erasmo (Venice’s “vegetable garden”) San Michele (cemetery island) San Lazzaro degli Armeni, San Servolo, La Certosa TimeStamps: 0:00:00 Venice's Narrow Streets 1:01:15 Canal Boat Trip 1:38:48 Venice Mainland 3:06:55 Golden Hour **Friendly Note: Hi there! This video was filmed during a peaceful walk through public spaces, where people may appear in the background. Everyone shown is just part of the natural street scene and not the focus of the video. If you notice yourself and would prefer not to be included, feel free to reach out here or at toyrister@gmail.com — I’m happy to make adjustments.**

title: Edinburgh — A Peaceful Stroll Through Scotland’s Most Beautiful City
description: There’s something about Edinburgh that stays with you. Maybe it’s the way the old stone buildings catch the light, or how the quiet streets feel like they’ve been waiting for centuries. It’s a city that doesn’t shout — it whispers, gently, through every detail. In this walk, I let the rhythm of the city lead me — through the winding alleys of the Old Town, past the shadows of the castle, and along peaceful corners most people pass by. No plan, no rush — just the feeling of being somewhere timeless. title: NABLUS, Palestine 🇵🇸 4K HDR Walking Tour | Everyday Life in the West Bank

title: Walking Tour of Lauterbrunnen | Switzerland 4K
description: Welcome to Lauterbrunnen, one of the most beautiful villages in Switzerland, nestled in the famous Valley of 72 Waterfalls. This walking tour takes you through charming streets, traditional Swiss chalets, and breathtaking alpine scenery surrounded by towering cliffs and cascading waterfalls. Filmed in crystal clear 4K with natural ambient sounds, this video is perfect for virtual travel, relaxation, or planning your dream trip to Switzerland. Feel the unique atmosphere of Lauterbrunnen as if you are there in person. 📍 Highlights of this walk: • Stroll through the heart of Lauterbrunnen village • Views of Staubbach Falls and surrounding cliffs • Traditional Swiss chalets and alpine meadows • Peaceful, immersive walk with no commentary — only natural sounds ✨ Discover why Lauterbrunnen is often called the most magical valley in the Swiss Alps! 👍 Support the channel: Like, comment, share and subscribe for more 4K walking tours of beautiful cities around the world. title: Polignano a Mare, Italy Walking Tour (4K/60fps)
description: WALKING IN POLIGNANO A MARE, ITALY: Be sure to turn on CLOSED CAPTIONING if you want to read the historical comments and descriptions. title: Riomaggiore Walking Tour - Cinque Terre - Prowalk Tours
description: Cinque Terre, meaning "Five Lands" consists of five coastal towns along the northwestern coast of Italy. Riomaggiore is the southern most town and is considered to be the starting point for hikers walking along the Via dell'Amore, a trail that joins all five villages. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - December 2021 Christmas Walk 🎅- 4K-UHD Walking Tour (▶3.5Hours)
description: Rome is my favorite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

Ravello: Join us on a serene walking tour through Ravello, one of the most beautiful towns on the Amalfi Coast, known for its stunning views, lush gardens, and rich history. We begin at Piazza Duomo, the heart of Ravello, where you can admire the historic Ravello Cathedral, dating back to the 11th century. After exploring the cathedral’s peaceful interior, we return to the lively piazza and then head up the scenic Via S. Giovanni del Toro. Our walk continues to the tranquil Giardini Principessa di Piemonte, a garden with breathtaking views of the Amalfi Coast. After visiting the garden behind the cathedral, we head toward the highlight of the tour: Villa Cimbrone. At Villa Cimbrone, we wander through the serene Cloister and stroll down the grand Avenue of Immensity, where the beauty of Ravello truly shines. As we wrap up our visit to the villa, we pass through Hortensia Avenue and admire the Statue of David before heading back to Piazza Duomo. History: Founded in the 5th century, Ravello has long been a haven for artists and writers. Its famous Villa Cimbrone, dating back to the 11th century, is renowned for its magnificent gardens and the Terrace of Infinity, offering one of the most spectacular views in Italy. Tips: Villa Cimbrone is best visited early in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the crowds. Wear comfortable shoes, as there are steps and cobblestone streets. title: Milan, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer 2024 - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Milan, the capital of Lombardy, is Italy's second-largest city and a global fashion and design powerhouse. Renowned for its high-end shopping, vibrant cultural scene, and historical significance, Milan seamlessly blends ancient heritage with modern innovation. Milan boasts a rich history, dating back to its foundation by Celtic Insubres and later flourishing under Roman rule. Key historical landmarks include the Gothic Cathedral, or Duomo di Milano, an architectural masterpiece with intricate spires and statues. The Sforza Castle, a Renaissance fortification, houses several museums and art collections, including works by Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci. Milan is a cultural epicenter, home to world-class museums, theaters, and art galleries. The renowned La Scala Opera House, a beacon of classical music and opera, regularly hosts performances by leading international artists. The city also celebrates contemporary art in venues such as the Museo del Novecento and Fondazione Prada. Often hailed as the fashion capital of the world, Milan hosts biannual fashion weeks, attracting top designers, models, and industry insiders. The Quadrilatero della Moda, an upscale shopping district, features flagship stores of luxury brands like Prada, Gucci, and Versace. Milan's influence extends to design, with the annual Salone del Mobile drawing global attention to its innovative furniture and interior design trends. Milan is Italy's financial hub, hosting the Italian Stock Exchange and headquarters of major banks and multinational corporations. The city excels in various industries, including finance, technology, and manufacturing, driving Italy's economy. In summary, Milan is a vibrant metropolis where history meets modernity, offering a unique blend of cultural richness, economic prowess, and cutting-edge design. Whether exploring its historic landmarks, indulging in luxury shopping, or experiencing its dynamic culinary and cultural scene, Milan captivates residents and visitors alike with its multifaceted charm.

title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - 2022 - 4K HDR Walking Tour (With Chapters) (▶222 min)
description: Rome has no rivals when it comes to beauty, history, art, nature, parks, architecture and monumentality. The city changes continuously, offering all possible architectural styles which often overlaps, creating two, often three or four level structures that might incorporate, for example, a baroque palace underneath which there might be a medieval church beneath which you might have a second century church under which there might be 3 levels of ancient catacombs. Additionally, the city displays the greatest amount of monuments and/or points of interest among all world cities, having about 15% of the entire world’s artistic/historic/archaeological/architectural/ inheritance. That is one-sixth of the world’s treasures condensed in one city. From skyscrapers to rationalism to neoclassicism to Art Deco to Renaissance to Baroque to Medieval to Neo-Gothic to imperial Rome…the list never ends. I cannot even begin to write about the Eternal City, so much is there. Here are 12 interesting facts about Rome. Modern Rome has 280 fountains and more than 900 churches. Nearly 700,000 euros worth of coins are tossed into Rome’s Trevi Fountain each year. The proceeds are donated to Caritas to help those in need. The Romans had built a road network of 53,000 miles by the early fourth century. Each Roman mile was about 4,800 feet and marked by a milestone, giving birth to the saying “All roads lead to Rome.” In Ancient Rome, only free-born men were allowed to wear togas, a sign of Roman citizenship. Women wore stolas, the female version of togas, made from linen. The mascot of Rome is a she-wolf that cared for brothers Romulus and Remus, the mythological founders of Rome. Rome became the capital city of unified Italy in 1870, taking the title from Florence. Law in Rome allows cats to live without disruption in the place they were born. Wild cats can be climbing the walls of the Colosseum, and sleeping among the ruins of the Forum. Women in ancient Rome dyed their hair with goat fat and beech wood ashes. The most popular colors were red and blond. The first ever shopping mall was built in Rome between 107 and 110 AD by Emperor Trajan. It sold a wide variety of goods and grocery items. Rome’s first university, La Sapienza, established in 1303 AD, is the largest in Europe and the second largest in the world. Rome has a museum dedicated entirely to pasta. St Peter’s basilica inside Vatican City is the largest church ever constructed. 0:00:00 Colosseo 0:11:37 Rione I Monti 0:23:01 Plazza Venezia 0:29:58 Via del Plebiscito 0:35:00 Rione Vi Parione 0:59:34 Castel Sant'Angelo 1:05:00 Vatican City 1:22:09 Piazza del Popolo 1:24:18 Via del Corso 1:34:53 Spanish Steps/Plaza di Spagna 1:37:05 Via del Condotti 2:00:00 Fontana di Trevi 2:18:45 COLONIA CITY OF ROME 2:40:00 PIAZZA DEL POPOLO 2:43:26 Via del Babuino 2:51:16 Plaza di Spagna 2:56:00 COLONIA CITY OF ROME 3:14:00 Plazza Venezia at Night 3:20:00 Rione I Monti at Night 3:29:00 Colosseo At Night ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Venice Italy 🇮🇹 - The Floating City - 4k HDR 60fps Walking Tour (▶238min)
description: ✈️ Follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/toyrister 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Venice, often referred to as the "City of Canals" or the "Queen of the Adriatic," is a mesmerizing and unique city situated in northeastern Italy. Built on a network of 118 small islands separated by canals and connected by a series of bridges, Venice is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most iconic destinations in the world. The heart of Venice is the Grand Canal, a central waterway that winds its way through the city, lined with elegant buildings, palaces, and historic churches. The cityscape is a captivating blend of Gothic and Renaissance architecture, featuring intricately detailed facades, arched bridges, and ornate balconies that seem to defy the passage of time. Venice is renowned for its artistic and cultural heritage. The city was a major center of trade and commerce during the Middle Ages, and this prosperity is reflected in its opulent palaces, such as the Palazzo Ducale (Doge's Palace) and Ca' d'Oro. The city is also home to a wealth of museums and galleries, housing masterpieces by renowned artists like Titian, Tintoretto, and Canaletto. Navigating Venice is a unique experience in itself. Instead of traditional roads, the city's primary thoroughfares are its picturesque canals, where iconic gondolas, water taxis, and vaporettos (water buses) transport locals and visitors alike. The absence of cars adds to the city's charm, creating a serene and intimate atmosphere that encourages leisurely strolls through narrow alleyways and across charming squares. Venice is celebrated for its annual Carnival, a vibrant and elaborate festival known for its masked balls, colorful parades, and lively atmosphere. Additionally, the city hosts the Venice Film Festival, one of the oldest and most prestigious film festivals in the world, attracting filmmakers and cinephiles from around the globe. Despite facing challenges such as rising sea levels and periodic flooding, Venice continues to captivate the imaginations of those who visit. Its enchanting beauty, rich history, and unique character make it a truly magical destination that leaves an indelible impression on all who have the privilege of exploring its timeless streets and waterways. title: Vienna Austria 🇦🇹 - Christmas Capital - 4K Walking Tour
description: Vienna at Christmas transforms into a magical winter wonderland, blending historic charm with festive cheer. The city’s grand architecture, from the Schönbrunn Palace to St. Stephen’s Cathedral, is illuminated by twinkling lights, creating an enchanting atmosphere. Streets are lined with intricately decorated Christmas trees, and the scent of roasted chestnuts, spiced mulled wine, and freshly baked gingerbread fills the air. The famous Christkindlmarkt at Rathausplatz is a centerpiece of the season, offering handmade ornaments, artisanal gifts, and indulgent treats in a charming setting. Smaller markets, like those at Belvedere Palace or Spittelberg, provide intimate experiences steeped in tradition. In addition to its markets, Vienna hosts festive concerts in venues like the Vienna State Opera and the Musikverein, where classical music resonates through the halls. Ice skaters glide across rinks at the Rathauspark, and horse-drawn carriages take visitors through the cobblestone streets dusted with snow. Christmas in Vienna is not just a celebration but a journey into timeless elegance and festive magic, perfect for families, couples, or solo travelers looking for holiday spirit. 0:00:00 Shorts 0:02:24 Vienna During The Day 1:45:57 Vienna During The Night ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me on toyrister@gmail.com or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

Information: Experience the captivating beauty of Pitigliano, one of Italy's most picturesque hilltop villages, in this immersive walking tour. Nestled in the Maremma region of Tuscany, Pitigliano is often called "Little Jerusalem" due to its long history of Jewish culture. This tour begins with stunning drone footage and a detailed map of our walking route, showcasing the architectural beauty and breathtaking landscapes of this ancient village. History: Pitigliano boasts a rich history that dates back to Etruscan times. The village has seen influences from the Romans, the Aldobrandeschi family, and the powerful Orsini family, who left their mark with the majestic Palazzo Orsini. Among Pitigliano’s iconic landmarks is the Medici Aqueduct, constructed in the 16th century to supply the town with fresh water. The heart of the village, Piazza della Repubblica, is home to the striking Fountain of the Seven Spouts. Ancient tunnels and cisterns run beneath the village, offering a glimpse into its fascinating past. Tourist Tips: Start your walk on Via San Michele and enjoy panoramic views of the village from Piazza G. Garibaldi. Visit Palazzo Orsini, a historical museum filled with Renaissance art and archaeological treasures. Don’t miss the impressive Pitigliano Cathedral, a Baroque-style church that dominates the town’s skyline. For the best photo opportunities, head to the Terrace lookout points (timestamps 45:33 and 53:30) for sweeping views of the valley. Be sure to explore the ancient tunnels and cisterns, which are part of the village’s intriguing underground world. Grab a bite at a local trattoria and try the area's famous wines, produced from vineyards surrounding the village. #Pitigliano #ItalyWalkingTour #LittleJerusalem #MedievalItaly #ProWalkTours #TuscanyVillages

title: Amalfi Coast Driving Tour - Italy 4K|60fps
description: Enjoy a 4K UHD tour along Italy's most beautiful coastline, The Amalfi Coast (Italian: Costiera Amalfitana) in this episode of Prowalk Tours. The Amalfi Drive, formerly known as the SS 163, is considered to be the most scenic stretch of coastline in Europe and one of the best coastal drives in the world. Unfortunately, when you are stuck in a car or in a bus, it is not possible to get a good view. In this scooter video, you will get the best possible view for the entire 80 km (50 miles). This video was filmed on September 7th, 2019. I started the day by renting a scooter at Jollyrents in Sorrento (link below). I mounted two cameras, the DJI Osmo Pocket and the Insta360 One X. The Osmo pocket video was filmed in 4K at 60fps. At minute 1:17:59, the Osmo Pocket camera battery died so the remaining part of the video is from the Insta360 One X camera. title: Edinburgh Scotland | 🎄 Christmas Ambient Walking Tour 4K
description: First Person Tour of Edinburgh Edinburgh is the capital of Scotland and it is located in central eastern Scotland, near the Firth of Forth, close to the North Sea. Thanks to its spectacular rocks, rustic buildings and a huge collection of medieval and classic architecture, including numerous stone decorations, it is often considered one of the most lively cities in Europe. Edinburgh is not only one of the most beautiful cities in Europe, it is a city with a fantastic position. The view falls on all sides – green hills, the hint of the blue sea, the silhouettes of the buildings and the red cliffs. It is a city that calls you to explore it by foot – narrow streets, passageways, stairs and hidden church yards on every step will pull you away from the main streets. The city is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the UK. It is the capital of Scotland and home to many tourist attractions. A visit here will be well worth it, considering the numerous things you can do and see. Most of the structures in the Old Town have remained in their original form over the years. Charming medieval relics are plenty in this section of the city. In contrast, orderly Georgian terraces line the streets of the New Town. The general urban scenery is a blend of ancient structures and modern architecture, which gives the city a unique character. In 1995, the Old Town was listed as a UNESCO Heritage Site. With year round festivals, a throbbing nightlife and an entertaining arts scene, Edinburgh never falls short of interesting travel ventures for tourists.

title: Valencia, Spain 🇪🇸 - The Ultimate Heaven - 4K-HDR Walking Tour
description: ✈️ Follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/toyrister 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Valencia, nestled on Spain's eastern coast along the Mediterranean Sea, is a captivating blend of old-world charm and modern innovation. As the third-largest city in Spain, Valencia is renowned for its rich history, stunning architecture, and vibrant cultural scene. At the heart of Valencia lies its historic center, where ancient streets wind their way past medieval buildings, charming squares, and bustling markets. The city's crown jewel is the magnificent Valencia Cathedral, a masterpiece of Gothic architecture that houses the revered Holy Grail. Beyond its historic core, Valencia embraces the future with striking modern landmarks, such as the futuristic City of Arts and Sciences complex, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava. This architectural marvel houses a science museum, an opera house, and Europe's largest aquarium, offering visitors a glimpse into the city's innovative spirit. Valencia's cultural scene is equally impressive, with world-class museums, galleries, and theaters showcasing a diverse array of artistic talent. From contemporary art exhibitions to traditional flamenco performances, there's always something captivating to experience in Valencia. But perhaps most famous of all is Valencia's lively spirit and zest for life, embodied in its vibrant festivals and celebrations. The annual Fallas festival, with its elaborate street parades and spectacular firework displays, is a testament to the city's festive traditions and community spirit. Of course, no visit to Valencia would be complete without indulging in its culinary delights. Renowned for its paella, Valencia's cuisine is a delicious fusion of Mediterranean flavors, with fresh seafood, aromatic spices, and locally grown produce taking center stage. With its blend of history, culture, innovation, and gastronomy, Valencia offers visitors a truly unforgettable experience. Whether exploring its historic landmarks, immersing oneself in its vibrant culture, or simply relaxing on its sun-drenched beaches, Valencia captivates the imagination and leaves a lasting impression on all who visit.

title: Florence, Italy 🇮🇹 - October 2022 - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Why is Italy so beautiful? Many people around the world wonder why Italy is so beautiful. The answer is on every street corner in any of Italy's cities. It's only when you walk around Florence that you realize why Italy is such a beautiful country. Florence in Italy is one of the most beautiful cities in the world. Where even the gardens, monuments, buildings, and streets are, in many cases, veritable masterpieces. Walking down the streets of Florence is like walking through the halls of a big open air museum. However, even if the outdoors has so much to offer, don’t forget that Florence is home to some of the most important ‘indoor museums’ in the world! The Uffizi museum, for example, is famous all around the globe (the ‘Primavera del Botticelli’ alone is worth a visit to the city) and the Galleria dell’Accademia has a wonderful gallery of statues, among them the Michelangelo’s world-celebrated David, among many more! Remember, Florence city center is listed as World Heritage site by UNESCO. So don't ask a Florentine citizen "how far is Tuscany from Florence?" because Florence is Tuscany in the world. title: Santorini, Greece 🇬🇷 - JULY 2024 - 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Santorini is a captivating Greek island nestled in the southern Aegean Sea, renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, charming architecture, and rich history. Formed by a volcanic caldera, the island boasts dramatic cliffs that plunge into the azure waters of the Aegean, creating a picture-perfect backdrop that has made Santorini a favorite among travelers and photographers. 00:00:00 OIA - Oia is a picturesque village on the northwestern tip of Santorini, famous for its stunning sunsets, whitewashed buildings, and blue-domed churches. Its narrow streets are lined with charming boutiques, art galleries, and cozy cafes, offering a serene and romantic atmosphere. 00:51:53 FIRA IN THE EVENING - Fira, the bustling capital of Santorini, comes alive in the evening with vibrant nightlife, restaurants, and bars. The town’s cliffside location provides panoramic views of the caldera and the sea, illuminated by the lights of the town as the sun sets. 01:22:42 FIRA IN THE MORNING - In the morning, Fira offers a peaceful ambiance with its winding streets and picturesque alleys. Visitors can enjoy a leisurely breakfast at one of the many cafes while taking in the breathtaking views of the caldera and the sea. 02:13:32 IMEROVIGLI - Imerovigli is a tranquil village located between Fira and Oia, known for its luxury hotels and stunning views. The village is perched on the highest point of the caldera edge, offering spectacular panoramas of the Aegean Sea and the sunset. 03:16:20 SANTORINI VOLCANIC MOUNTAINS - The volcanic mountains of Santorini are a testament to the island’s dramatic geological history. Visitors can hike the rugged terrain and explore the remnants of ancient volcanic activity, which have shaped the island’s unique landscape.

title: MEDINA, Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 Al-Masjid an-Nabawi to Masjid Quba | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Medina walking tour takes you through some of the most important and sacred locations in the city, capturing the spiritual atmosphere of Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah from day into night. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this Medina city walk shows daily life around the Prophet’s Mosque, moments of prayer, and the calm rhythm of the city as pilgrims move through these historic places. We begin at the entrance of Masjid an-Nabawi and walk inside the mosque, experiencing the peaceful interior and the surrounding courtyard. The route continues outside the mosque, passing beneath the famous umbrellas as they close, and offering views of the Green Dome above the Prophet’s burial chamber. From there, the walk leads to Masjid Abu Bakr As-Siddiq and Al-Ghamama Mosque, continues along Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari Street and Quba Road, and includes the azan echoing through Medina. The tour then reaches Masjid Al-Jumuah and finally Quba Mosque, the first mosque in Islam, before driving back toward Masjid an-Nabawi. 🎥 Perfect for those searching for Medina walking tour 4K, Masjid an-Nabawi walk, Prophet’s Mosque Medina, Islamic holy sites walking tour, Medina city walk, or virtual walks through Al-Madinah. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🕌 Masjid an-Nabawi – The Prophet’s Mosque in Medina 🟢 Green Dome – Above the Prophet’s burial chamber ☂️ Mosque Courtyard – Closing umbrellas and daily rhythm 🕌 Masjid Abu Bakr As-Siddiq & Al-Ghamama Mosque 🚶 Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari Street – Historic surroundings 🛣️ Quba Road – Route toward early Islamic sites 🕌 Masjid Al-Jumuah – Important historical mosque 🕌 Quba Mosque – The first mosque in the world 🕋 Spiritual Atmosphere – Prayer, azan, and calm city life 📌 About Medina: Medina is one of the holiest cities in Islam and holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims around the world. The city is centered around Masjid an-Nabawi and connected to key moments in Islamic history through its mosques and streets. This 4K Medina walking tour captures the city respectfully and naturally, focusing on atmosphere, devotion, and everyday life around sacred places. 🕒 Chapters: 0:00 Masjid an-Nabawi Entrance 6:15 Inside Masjid an-Nabawi 15:05 Masjid an-Nabawi Outside Area 20:42 Green Dome above the Prophet’s burial chamber 23:20 Umbrellas at the Prophet’s Mosque closing 27:15 Continuing at the outside area of the Prophet’s Mosque 36:55 Masjid Abu Bakr As-Siddiq & Al-Ghamama Mosque 39:54 Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari Street 44:00 Quba Road 1:09:13 Azan in Medina 1:10:16 Masjid Al-Jumuah Outside 1:12:17 Masjid Al-Jumuah Inside 1:13:08 Quba Road at Night 1:18:05 Quba Mosque Outside 1:21:49 Quba Mosque Inside 1:23:40 Driving back to Masjid an-Nabawi 🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Medina, Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 📽️ Format: 4K at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️🌙 Time: Day to Night Which part of this Medina walking tour felt most meaningful to you – the time inside Masjid an-Nabawi, the moment near the Green Dome, or the visit to Quba Mosque? 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: WARSAW, Poland 🇵🇱 Europe’s Next Economic Power | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Warsaw walking tour takes you from the modern heart of Poland’s capital to its historic Old Town showcasing the perfect blend of skyscrapers, culture, and centuries-old architecture. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this walk captures the vibrant and authentic atmosphere of Warsaw. We begin at the Palace of Culture and Science, one of the city’s most iconic landmarks, with views over the skyline and the nearby Złote Tarasy shopping mall. The walk continues along Marszałkowska and Chmielna Streets, before reaching Nowy Świat – one of Warsaw’s most beautiful boulevards filled with cafés, restaurants, and shops. From there, we pass the Nicolaus Copernicus Monument, Holy Cross Church, and Warsaw University before walking down Krakowskie Przedmieście toward the Presidential Palace. The tour ends at Castle Square and the Royal Castle, leading into the colorful and historic Old Town with its famous Barbakan walls and cobblestone streets. 🎥 Perfect for those searching for Warsaw walking tour 4K, Warsaw Old Town, Palace of Culture and Science, Nowy Świat Warsaw, Krakowskie Przedmieście, Royal Castle Warsaw, or virtual city walks through Poland. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🏙️ Palace of Culture and Science – Warsaw’s most famous skyscraper 🏬 Złote Tarasy Mall – Modern shopping and architecture 🚶 Marszałkowska & Chmielna Streets – Central Warsaw atmosphere ☕ Nowy Świat – Elegant boulevard with cafés & nightlife 🪐 Nicolaus Copernicus Monument – Tribute to Poland’s famous astronomer ⛪ Holy Cross Church – Historic landmark on Krakowskie Przedmieście 🏫 Warsaw University – Academic and cultural center 🏛️ Presidential Palace – Official residence of the Polish President 🏰 Castle Square & Royal Castle – Entrance to Warsaw’s Old Town 🎨 Warsaw Old Town & Barbakan – UNESCO World Heritage & colorful charm 📌 About Warsaw: Warsaw is a city of contrasts – a mix of modern glass towers and beautifully restored historic streets. Destroyed during World War II and meticulously rebuilt, it now stands as one of Europe’s most dynamic capitals, combining innovation with history, culture, and resilience. 🕒 Chapters: 0:00 Palace of Culture and Science View 04:41 Złote Tarasy Mall 13:49 Around Palace of Culture and Science 21:42 Marszałkowska 24:21 Chmielna 33:40 New World Street – Nowy Świat 42:46 Nicolaus Copernicus Monument 48:50 Holy Cross Church 53:56 Warsaw University 58:33 Krakowskie Przedmieście 1:03:27 Presidential Palace 1:10:53 Castle Square (Plac Zamkowy) & Sigismund’s Column 1:14:53 Royal Castle in Warsaw 1:17:10 Famous Old Town 1:25:13 Barbakan & Old Town 🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Warsaw, Poland 🇵🇱 📽️ Format: 4K at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️ Time: Daytime Which part of this Warsaw walking tour would you enjoy most – the modern skyline, the elegant Nowy Świat boulevard, or the colorful Old Town around the Royal Castle? 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: NABLUS, Palestine 🇵🇸 4K HDR Walking Tour 2025 | Authentic Street Life, Old City & Markets
description: Step into the heart of Nablus – a Palestinian city full of history, culture, and real street energy. This 4K walking tour captures the Old City’s atmosphere like never before. Join us on a real-time journey through the *Old City of Nablus*, one of the oldest continuously inhabited urban centers in the Middle East. Walk through narrow stone alleys, past spice vendors, soap makers, sweet shops, cafés, mosques, and everyday Palestinian life – all filmed in stunning 4K with natural sounds and no commentary. 🎥 Perfect for virtual explorers, culture lovers, Middle East enthusiasts, and anyone curious about daily life in Palestine. --- 📍 *Tour Highlights:* – *Old City of Nablus* – A maze of ancient stone streets and local character – *Street Markets (Souks)* – Fresh produce, spices, textiles, sweets, and more – *Traditional Hammams & Mosques* – Centuries of Islamic and Ottoman influence – *Kanafeh shops & bakeries* – Taste the birthplace of the famous Palestinian dessert – *Local crafts & olive oil soap* – Heritage and handmade identity – *People & daily life* – Real faces, real voices, real Palestine --- 📖 *About Nablus, Palestine:* Nablus is a major city in the northern *West Bank*, nestled between Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim. Known for its vibrant Old City, famous *Nabulsi kanafeh*, and traditional olive oil soap, Nablus is both a cultural hub and a symbol of Palestinian resilience. Historically a center of trade and learning, the city has preserved its Arab identity through architecture, hospitality, and community. title: Santorini, Greece 🇬🇷 - Summer 2024 - 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Santorini is a captivating Greek island nestled in the southern Aegean Sea, renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, charming architecture, and rich history. Formed by a volcanic caldera, the island boasts dramatic cliffs that plunge into the azure waters of the Aegean, creating a picture-perfect backdrop that has made Santorini a favorite among travelers and photographers. The iconic architecture of Santorini is characterized by whitewashed buildings with blue-domed roofs, creating a striking contrast against the deep blue sky and sea. The narrow, winding streets of its main towns, such as Fira and Oia, are lined with charming cafes, boutiques, and traditional Greek tavernas, offering visitors a delightful blend of modern amenities and authentic island life. Santorini's history is as fascinating as its scenery. The island is often associated with the ancient Minoan civilization and the legend of the lost city of Atlantis. Visitors can explore archaeological sites like Akrotiri, a well-preserved ancient city that was preserved in volcanic ash, offering a glimpse into the island's past. The island is renowned for its stunning sunsets, particularly in the village of Oia, where crowds gather every evening to witness the sun dip below the horizon, casting a warm glow over the whitewashed buildings and creating a magical atmosphere. For those seeking relaxation, Santorini offers beautiful beaches with unique volcanic sand, such as the Red Beach and Perissa Beach. The therapeutic hot springs at Palea Kameni, another result of the island's volcanic activity, provide a rejuvenating experience amidst the picturesque surroundings. Whether you're drawn to its captivating history, charming architecture, or mesmerizing landscapes, Santorini stands as a timeless destination that captures the hearts of all who visit, leaving an indelible imprint of its beauty and allure.
