title: Paros, Greece 🇬🇷 | The Budget-Friendly Mykonos | 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Paros, a hidden gem nestled in the heart of the Aegean Sea. With its idyllic beaches, charming villages, and rich cultural heritage, Paros is a paradise waiting to be explored. As you step foot on this enchanting Greek island, you'll be greeted by pristine beaches with crystal-clear turquoise waters. Golden sands stretch along the coastline, inviting you to relax under the warm Mediterranean sun. From the famous Santa Maria Beach to the secluded Kolymbithres Beach with its unique rock formations, there's a beach for every preference, whether you seek tranquility or water sports excitement. Beyond the beaches, Paros boasts a picturesque landscape dotted with whitewashed villages and traditional Cycladic architecture. Wander through the labyrinthine streets of Parikia, the island's capital, and discover charming boutiques, local tavernas, and quaint cafes. Explore the historic Parikia Castle, visit the impressive Church of Panagia Ekatontapiliani (Church of 100 Doors), and soak in the panoramic views from the hilltop of Kastro. For a taste of authentic Greek island life, venture to the charming village of Naoussa. Lose yourself in its narrow alleys lined with colorful houses, bougainvillea-clad walls, and traditional fishing boats bobbing in the harbor. Enjoy fresh seafood at waterfront tavernas, browse through boutique shops, and witness the vibrant nightlife that comes alive after sunset. Paros is also a haven for water sports enthusiasts. Embark on thrilling windsurfing or kiteboarding adventures at Golden Beach or Pounda Beach, where the Meltemi winds create ideal conditions for adrenaline-pumping experiences. Discover the underwater wonders of the Aegean Sea through snorkeling or scuba diving, exploring hidden coves and vibrant marine life. Immerse yourself in the island's rich history and culture by visiting the ancient marble quarries of Marathi, where the famous Parian marble was sourced. Explore the Byzantine Road that connects Lefkes and Prodromos, revealing stunning vistas of the island's interior. Discover traditional pottery workshops, where skilled artisans continue age-old craftsmanship. Indulge in the flavors of Paros by savoring local delicacies such as freshly caught fish, juicy olives, and delectable cheeses. Pair your meal with the island's renowned wines, which are produced from grapes grown in the fertile valleys and vineyards. Paros is an island that invites you to slow down, immerse yourself in its natural beauty, and embrace the relaxed Greek island lifestyle. Whether you seek sun-drenched beaches, cultural exploration, or culinary delights, Paros offers an unforgettable experience that will leave you enchanted and yearning to return. 0:00:00 Intro Scenes 0:03:34 Naousa 1:44:44 Parikia

title: Italy's Most Beautiful Garden - The Garden of Ninfa Walking Tour
description: The GARDEN OF NINFA is considered to be one of the most beautiful in the world. It also has a very interesting history. Ninfa started as a town on the main route between Rome and Naples. After the fall of the Roman Empire, the Holy Roman Empire gave this land to the Pope. Years later in 1297, another Pope gave the property to his nephew, a member of the Caetani family. The property was owned by the Caetani family for 680 years, all the way up until 1977. Ninfa has been the site of an English Garden since 1921. 🎧For an even more immersive experience, be sure to put on your headphones and listen in 3D audio. ►Map of the Walk◄ https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/edit?mid=1RuRDoZJMEhRiiASNl4zVTOugV-oNMaW1&usp=sharing ►►Video Timeline Links◄◄ 0:00 Drone Video Intro 1:03 Walk begins 3:14 Stream and mini-waterfall 7:16 Ruins 8:20 Cypress Avenue 9:27 Santa Maria Maggiore (Church Ruins) 16:48 Massare Bridge (Ponte del Macello) 19:46 Roman Bridge from 200AD 22:18 Bamboo Forest 22:40 Bridge #3 25:32 Flower covered gate & Ruins 27:19 Castle Gardens ►►►SUPPORT THE CHANNEL◄◄◄ 🔴Subscribe for more videos just like this: https://www.youtube.com/c/Prowalktours?sub_confirmation=1 🔵Support this channel on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Prowalks 🟢Make a donation: https://www.paypal.me/ProWalks ►►►THE EQUIPMENT I USE◄◄◄ https://www.amazon.com/shop/prowalktours I would like to thank Dino Spumoni and Andrey Antsut for being a top level Patreon Supporter! title: Volterra, Italy Walking Tour - 4K - with Captions!
description: This walking tour of VOLTERRA, ITALY was filmed on Wednesday August 4th, 2021 starting at 11:28 AM at the Piazza Martiri della Libertà. title: Monte Carlo, Monaco 🇲🇨 🌴 - High-End Luxury Playground - 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: Monaco is a small city-state located on the French Riviera, renowned for its glamour, luxury, and Mediterranean charm. The city is famous for its beautiful natural surroundings, picturesque harbor, and iconic landmarks. Monte Carlo, the most famous district of Monaco, is home to many luxury hotels, casinos, and high-end shopping boutiques. Visitors can stroll along the beautiful Promenade des Anglais, which offers stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and the surrounding hills. One of the most iconic landmarks of Monaco is the Prince's Palace, which is the official residence of the ruling Grimaldi family. The palace is open to the public during certain times of the year, and visitors can witness the changing of the guard ceremony. Another famous attraction in Monaco is the Cathedral of Our Lady Immaculate, which is the final resting place of the late Prince Rainier III and his wife, the famous Hollywood actress Grace Kelly. The cathedral boasts impressive architecture and beautiful stained glass windows. Monaco is also renowned for its Formula 1 Grand Prix, which takes place annually in Monte Carlo. The narrow streets of the city provide an exciting and challenging course for the drivers and a thrilling spectacle for the spectators. The Oceanographic Museum of Monaco is another must-see attraction, featuring over 6,000 marine species and a 90,000-liter shark tank. Visitors can also enjoy the beautiful Jardin Exotique, home to a stunning collection of cacti and succulents. In summary, Monaco Monte Carlo offers a unique blend of luxury, culture, and natural beauty, making it a must-visit destination for travelers and tourists seeking a taste of Mediterranean glamour. title: Mt. St. Helens Hiking Tour 🌋 Johnston Ridge to Windy Ridge | 9.5 Miles Through the Blast Zone 4K
description: *A 9.5-mile hike through the Mt. St. Helens blast zone* — one of the most dramatic and humbling landscapes in the United States. This hike begins at Johnston Ridge Observatory, follows the Boundary Trail No. 1 (Eruption Trail) out to Devil's Elbow, then descends the Truman Trail across the Pumice Plain all the way to Windy Ridge — with a stunning view of Spirit Lake along the way. The video ends with a never-before- seen eruption slideshow from May 18th, 1980. 📅 *Filmed on:* Saturday, July 13th 2018 | 9:00 AM 🌞 *Weather:* 13°C | 55°F 📍 *Location:* Mt. St. Helens, Lewis County, WA, USA 📏 *Distance:* 9.5 Miles 🗺️ *Map of the Walk:* https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1d_hETqvtonL0QkalGTFFzXuu5cN6F197&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ *TOUR TIMELINE* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro 0:45 Johnston Ridge Observatory 2:41 Boundary Trail No. 1 — Eruption Trail 10:16 Eruption Memorial 11:15 End of Paved Trail 40:00 Devil's Elbow 58:46 Truman Trail 1:18:05 Pumice Plain 1:34:00 Spirit Lake View 3:09:39 Windy Ridge 3:22:00 May 18th Eruption Slideshow — Never Before Seen Photos ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🏛️ *ABOUT MT. ST. HELENS* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ On May 18th, 1980, Mt. St. Helens erupted in the deadliest and most economically destructive volcanic event in U.S. history. The eruption killed 57 people, including volcanologist David Johnston, who was stationed at the ridge that now bears his name. The lateral blast flattened 230 square miles of forest in minutes and sent ash across 11 states. Spirit Lake, visible at 1:34:00, was completely transformed — its surface raised by 200 feet and still covered with floating logs from the devastated forest. The Pumice Plain crossed on the Truman Trail was created by pyroclastic flows and remains one of the most active recovery zones in the monument. Harry Truman, the 83-year-old caretaker of Spirit Lake Lodge who refused to evacuate, is buried somewhere beneath the debris. The mountain continues to be monitored for volcanic activity today. title: Seville, Spain 🇪🇸 | Summer 2023 | 4K-HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Seville, the vibrant capital of Spain's Andalusia region, is a city that effortlessly combines rich history, stunning architecture, and a passionate zest for life. Nestled along the banks of the Guadalquivir River, Seville is a city that captivates visitors with its timeless charm and modern vitality. Historical Legacy: Seville boasts a history that spans over two millennia, and this deep-rooted heritage is proudly displayed throughout the city. The iconic Alcázar of Seville, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, stands as a testament to the city's Moorish past. Its intricate Islamic architecture, lush gardens, and opulent interiors transport visitors to a bygone era. Nearby, the colossal Seville Cathedral, another UNESCO gem, rises in Gothic splendor. Inside, the tomb of Christopher Columbus adds an extra layer of historical significance. Majestic Architecture: Stroll through the historic center, and you'll encounter a breathtaking blend of architectural styles. The twisting streets of the Santa Cruz neighborhood, once the Jewish quarter, are lined with whitewashed buildings adorned with colorful tiles and wrought-iron balconies. The Metropol Parasol, affectionately known as "Las Setas" or "The Mushrooms," is a modern architectural marvel, offering panoramic views of the city from its wavy wooden structure. Flamenco and Festivals: Seville is synonymous with flamenco, the passionate and expressive Spanish art form. Locals and visitors alike can savor the soul-stirring rhythms and emotional performances in intimate tablaos or during the city's numerous festivals, such as the Feria de Abril. This week-long celebration transforms Seville into a spectacle of flamenco, colorful dresses, and horse-drawn carriages, drawing revelers from around the world. Culinary Delights: Spanish cuisine is renowned worldwide, and Seville is no exception. Tapas bars fill the streets, tempting taste buds with an array of mouthwatering small dishes. From succulent Iberian ham and fresh seafood to traditional gazpacho and creamy salmorejo, Seville's gastronomy is a culinary adventure waiting to be explored. Don't forget to sip on a glass of Andalusian sherry or sample the local orange-infused wine. Warm Hospitality: One of the defining characteristics of Seville is the warmth of its people. Sevillanos are known for their friendliness and genuine hospitality, making visitors feel at home in this enchanting city. Whether you're enjoying a lively conversation in a local tavern or joining in a spontaneous dance in the streets during a festival, you'll quickly understand the spirit of Seville. Seville, a city that effortlessly marries its storied past with a vibrant present, invites you to immerse yourself in its rich culture, savor its culinary delights, and feel the heartbeat of Andalusia. It's a destination where history comes alive, passions run deep, and every moment is a celebration of life. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: MUNICH, Germany 🇩🇪 Luxury, History & Bavarian Pride | 4K Walking Tour
description: Explore Munich, the capital of Bavaria, in this real-time 4K walking tour. Known for its historic squares, beer culture, and elegant architecture, Munich is one of Europe’s most beautiful and livable cities. This Munich walking tour begins at the central train station (Hauptbahnhof) before heading into the old town. We pass through Marienplatz with the world-famous Glockenspiel, stroll past the Viktualienmarkt food market, and continue along Maximilianstraße with its luxury boutiques. The walk also includes Odeonsplatz, a square surrounded by stunning baroque and neoclassical architecture, before finishing in Munich’s lively city streets. 🎥 Perfect for viewers searching for Munich walking tour 4K, Bavaria city walk, Marienplatz Munich, or virtual tours of Germany. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🚉 Hauptbahnhof – Munich’s central gateway 🏛️ Marienplatz – The historic heart of the city with the Glockenspiel 🛍️ Maximilianstraße – Luxury shopping street 🍻 Viktualienmarkt – Traditional Bavarian market with food & beer 🎶 Odeonsplatz – Iconic square with Theatinerkirche and Feldherrnhalle 📌 About Munich: Munich is Germany’s third-largest city and a cultural hub famous for Oktoberfest, beer gardens, art museums, and architecture. From medieval buildings in the Altstadt to modern boulevards, it combines Bavarian tradition with international flair, making it a must-see European destination. 🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Munich, Germany 📽️ Format: 4K UHD at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real ambient city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️ Time: Daytime, summer Would you rather explore Munich’s historic squares or spend your time in its lively beer gardens? 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: Monte Carlo, Monaco 🇲🇨 🌴 - The Playground of the Rich and Famous - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Monaco is a small city-state located on the French Riviera, renowned for its glamour, luxury, and Mediterranean charm. The city is famous for its beautiful natural surroundings, picturesque harbor, and iconic landmarks. Monte Carlo, the most famous district of Monaco, is home to many luxury hotels, casinos, and high-end shopping boutiques. Visitors can stroll along the beautiful Promenade des Anglais, which offers stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and the surrounding hills. One of the most iconic landmarks of Monaco is the Prince's Palace, which is the official residence of the ruling Grimaldi family. The palace is open to the public during certain times of the year, and visitors can witness the changing of the guard ceremony. Another famous attraction in Monaco is the Cathedral of Our Lady Immaculate, which is the final resting place of the late Prince Rainier III and his wife, the famous Hollywood actress Grace Kelly. The cathedral boasts impressive architecture and beautiful stained glass windows. Monaco is also renowned for its Formula 1 Grand Prix, which takes place annually in Monte Carlo. The narrow streets of the city provide an exciting and challenging course for the drivers and a thrilling spectacle for the spectators. The Oceanographic Museum of Monaco is another must-see attraction, featuring over 6,000 marine species and a 90,000-liter shark tank. Visitors can also enjoy the beautiful Jardin Exotique, home to a stunning collection of cacti and succulents. In summary, Monaco Monte Carlo offers a unique blend of luxury, culture, and natural beauty, making it a must-visit destination for travelers and tourists seeking a taste of Mediterranean glamour. title: Bratislava, Slovakia 🇸🇰| Europe's Best Capitals | 4k HDR 60fps Walking Tour (▶186min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia, is a city of charm and history nestled at the crossroads of central Europe. Known for its picturesque setting along the Danube River, Bratislava blends medieval grandeur with contemporary style. The city's compact old town is a joy to explore, with winding alleys leading to grand squares like the Main Square (Hlavné námestie), showcasing the elegant Old Town Hall and the colorful Roland Fountain. The Bratislava Castle, perched on a hill, offers panoramic views of the city and the river, with its four corner towers symbolizing the city's dynamic history. The castle grounds are a favorite leisure spot for both locals and tourists. Below, the UFO Bridge stands out with its futuristic observation deck, from where you can see Austria and, on clear days, Hungary. Culturally, the city is vibrant, hosting various festivals and events throughout the year. The Slovak National Theatre stages opera, ballet, and drama, and there are numerous galleries and museums like the Slovak National Museum and the Bratislava City Museum that delve into the rich tapestry of Slovak history and art. Cafes and restaurants dot the cityscape, offering a taste of local flavors like Bryndzové halušky, a traditional potato dish. The city is also known for its lively bars and nightlife, with a youthful energy that complements its ancient streets. Bratislava is not just a historical gem; it's also a modern, forward-looking city with a friendly, laid-back vibe that makes visitors feel right at home.

title: SAN FRANCISCO, USA 🇺🇸 America’s Most Expensive City | 4K Walking Tour

title: San Francisco Waterfront Walking Tour 🌉 Fisherman's Wharf to Golden Gate Bridge | 13.5 Miles 4K
description: The ultimate San Francisco waterfront walk — 13.5 miles along the northern coastline from Pier 39 at Fisherman's Wharf all the way to the Golden Gate Bridge, including a full crossing to the Marin Headlands and back. This is one of the greatest urban walks in the world, and this video gives you the complete experience in stunning 4K. Along the way: sea lions at Pier 39, the WWII museum ships at Pier 45, the historic Hyde Street Pier, Aquatic Park, Fort Mason, Marina Green, the Palace of Fine Arts, Crissy Field, Fort Point, and two full crossings of the Golden Gate Bridge. 📅 *Filmed on:* Saturday, August 4th, 2018 🕰 *Start time:* 1:05 PM 🌞 *Weather* 19°C | 67°F 🌡 📍 *Location:* San Francisco, California, USA 📏 *Distance:* 13.5 Miles 🗺️ *Map of the Walk:* https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1IciyqA2CDXmsu51S7Evz-G2p25Onlea7&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ *TOUR TIMELINE* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro 1:18 Map of the Walk 4:18 Pier 39 — Fisherman's Wharf 7:47 Pier 39 Carousel 11:02 Sea Lions 22:20 Pier 41 29:55 Pier 43 — Ferry Arch 35:40 Pier 45 — WWII Museum Ships 41:35 Boudin Bakery & Cafe 44:37 Fisherman's Wharf Sign 46:10 Fisherman's Grotto 53:17 Pier 47 57:28 The Cannery 59:36 Hyde Street Pier & C.A. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer Walk ☀️ - 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶115min)
description: Rome is my favorite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday! This video was recorded in September of 2021! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Malaga, Spain 🇪🇸 Summer 2023 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶97min)
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Malaga, a vibrant coastal city nestled on Spain's stunning Costa del Sol. With its rich history, vibrant culture, and Mediterranean charm, Malaga offers a captivating blend of old-world elegance and modern delights. As you explore the city, you'll be greeted by a captivating mix of architectural wonders. Marvel at the imposing Alcazaba, a Moorish fortress that dates back to the 11th century, and its neighboring Roman Theatre, a testament to the city's ancient past. Discover the stunning Malaga Cathedral, known as "La Manquita" (the one-armed lady) due to its unfinished south tower, and admire its intricate Renaissance and Baroque design. Wander through the narrow streets of the historic center, known as the Casco Antiguo, where you'll find charming plazas, bustling markets, and delightful tapas bars. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of Plaza de la Merced, the birthplace of renowned artist Pablo Picasso. Explore the Picasso Museum, housed in a beautiful 16th-century palace, and discover the fascinating works that chronicle the artist's life and artistic evolution. Malaga is also blessed with picturesque beaches that line its coastline. Enjoy the golden sands and azure waters of Malagueta Beach, where you can relax under the warm Mediterranean sun or take a refreshing dip in the sea. Alternatively, venture further along the coast to discover hidden coves and quieter stretches of shoreline, where you can escape the crowds and embrace a tranquil beach experience. Indulge in the culinary delights of Malaga by sampling traditional Andalusian cuisine. Savor fresh seafood, such as the famous Malaga fried fish or succulent grilled sardines, paired with a glass of local Malaga wine. Explore the lively food markets, such as Mercado Central de Atarazanas, where you can discover an array of fresh produce, regional specialties, and delightful tapas. Malaga's cultural scene is thriving, with a variety of museums and galleries to explore. Visit the Contemporary Art Center (CAC) to experience thought-provoking exhibitions, or venture to the Centre Pompidou Malaga, a vibrant space showcasing contemporary art from the renowned Parisian museum. Discover the innovative Muelle Uno, a modern waterfront development with trendy shops, restaurants, and stunning views of the harbor. title: Istanbul 🇹🇷 - Turkey's Busiest city - 4k HDR 60fps Walking Tour (▶76min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Istanbul, a vibrant metropolis straddling two continents, serves as a mesmerizing bridge between Europe and Asia. As Turkey's largest city, Istanbul embodies an intriguing blend of ancient history and modernity, offering visitors a unique and unforgettable experience. At the heart of Istanbul lies the captivating Old City, where the architectural marvel of Hagia Sophia stands tall, once a cathedral, later a mosque, and now a museum, showcasing the city's rich cultural heritage. Nearby, the grand Blue Mosque, adorned with intricate blue tiles, presents a stunning example of Ottoman architecture. The Topkapi Palace, once the residence of Ottoman sultans, offers a glimpse into the opulent lives of the past rulers. Beyond its historical treasures, Istanbul is a bustling hub of activity. The Grand Bazaar, one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets, entices with its maze of narrow lanes filled with colorful stalls selling spices, textiles, and unique souvenirs. The Spice Bazaar, another sensory delight, overflows with the aroma of exotic spices, teas, and Turkish delights. Istanbul's culinary scene is equally diverse and enticing. From savoring delectable kebabs and baklava in local eateries to indulging in gourmet cuisine in upscale restaurants, the city caters to every palate. Turkish tea and coffee culture, enjoyed in the city's cozy cafes, offer a taste of the country's warm hospitality. The city's landscape is adorned with stunning natural beauty, including the sparkling Bosphorus Strait, separating Europe and Asia. A leisurely cruise along the Bosphorus offers breathtaking views of historic landmarks, modern skyscrapers, and charming waterfront mansions. Istanbul's modern side is just as intriguing, with trendy neighborhoods like Beyoglu and Karakoy, where contemporary art galleries, stylish boutiques, and lively nightlife venues dot the streets. The city's ever-changing skyline, marked by architectural marvels like the Istanbul Sapphire, showcases its progressive spirit. Above all, Istanbul is a city of contrasts, where ancient traditions seamlessly merge with a fast-paced contemporary lifestyle. Its warm and welcoming people, coupled with its rich history and dynamic energy, make Istanbul an enchanting destination that leaves a lasting impression on all who visit. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will make sure that you are not on this video anymore.***

title: Malaga, Spain 🇪🇸 Summer 2023 4K-HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Malaga, a vibrant coastal city nestled on Spain's stunning Costa del Sol. With its rich history, vibrant culture, and Mediterranean charm, Malaga offers a captivating blend of old-world elegance and modern delights. As you explore the city, you'll be greeted by a captivating mix of architectural wonders. Marvel at the imposing Alcazaba, a Moorish fortress that dates back to the 11th century, and its neighboring Roman Theatre, a testament to the city's ancient past. Discover the stunning Malaga Cathedral, known as "La Manquita" (the one-armed lady) due to its unfinished south tower, and admire its intricate Renaissance and Baroque design. Wander through the narrow streets of the historic center, known as the Casco Antiguo, where you'll find charming plazas, bustling markets, and delightful tapas bars. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of Plaza de la Merced, the birthplace of renowned artist Pablo Picasso. Explore the Picasso Museum, housed in a beautiful 16th-century palace, and discover the fascinating works that chronicle the artist's life and artistic evolution. Malaga is also blessed with picturesque beaches that line its coastline. Enjoy the golden sands and azure waters of Malagueta Beach, where you can relax under the warm Mediterranean sun or take a refreshing dip in the sea. Alternatively, venture further along the coast to discover hidden coves and quieter stretches of shoreline, where you can escape the crowds and embrace a tranquil beach experience. Indulge in the culinary delights of Malaga by sampling traditional Andalusian cuisine. Savor fresh seafood, such as the famous Malaga fried fish or succulent grilled sardines, paired with a glass of local Malaga wine. Explore the lively food markets, such as Mercado Central de Atarazanas, where you can discover an array of fresh produce, regional specialties, and delightful tapas. Malaga's cultural scene is thriving, with a variety of museums and galleries to explore. Visit the Contemporary Art Center (CAC) to experience thought-provoking exhibitions, or venture to the Centre Pompidou Malaga, a vibrant space showcasing contemporary art from the renowned Parisian museum. Discover the innovative Muelle Uno, a modern waterfront development with trendy shops, restaurants, and stunning views of the harbor. As the sun sets, Malaga comes alive with a vibrant nightlife scene. Explore the lively bars and clubs in the city center, where you can dance the night away to a mix of international and Spanish music, or simply unwind with a cocktail and soak in the energetic atmosphere. With its captivating history, cultural treasures, beautiful beaches, and warm hospitality, Malaga offers a truly unforgettable experience. Whether you're exploring the city's rich heritage, enjoying a leisurely beach day, or indulging in its vibrant culinary and nightlife scene, Malaga invites you to embrace its unique blend of Mediterranean charm and Andalusian allure. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - 2022 - 4K HDR Walking Tour (With Chapters) (▶3 hours)
description: This video of Rome Was filmed in January of 2022. Rome has no rivals when it comes to beauty, history, art, nature, parks, architecture and monumentality. The city changes continuously, offering all possible architectural styles which often overlaps, creating two, often three or four level structures that might incorporate, for example, a baroque palace underneath which there might be a medieval church beneath which you might have a second century church under which there might be 3 levels of ancient catacombs. Additionally, the city displays the greatest amount of monuments and/or points of interest among all world cities, having about 15% of the entire world’s artistic/historic/archaeological/architectural/ inheritance. That is one-sixth of the world’s treasures condensed in one city. From skyscrapers to rationalism to neoclassicism to Art Deco to Renaissance to Baroque to Medieval to Neo-Gothic to imperial Rome…the list never ends. I cannot even begin to write about the Eternal City, so much is there. Here are 12 interesting facts about Rome. Modern Rome has 280 fountains and more than 900 churches. Nearly 700,000 euros worth of coins are tossed into Rome’s Trevi Fountain each year. The proceeds are donated to Caritas to help those in need. The Romans had built a road network of 53,000 miles by the early fourth century. Each Roman mile was about 4,800 feet and marked by a milestone, giving birth to the saying “All roads lead to Rome.” In Ancient Rome, only free-born men were allowed to wear togas, a sign of Roman citizenship. Women wore stolas, the female version of togas, made from linen. The mascot of Rome is a she-wolf that cared for brothers Romulus and Remus, the mythological founders of Rome. Rome became the capital city of unified Italy in 1870, taking the title from Florence. Law in Rome allows cats to live without disruption in the place they were born. Wild cats can be climbing the walls of the Colosseum, and sleeping among the ruins of the Forum. Women in ancient Rome dyed their hair with goat fat and beech wood ashes. The most popular colors were red and blond. The first ever shopping mall was built in Rome between 107 and 110 AD by Emperor Trajan. It sold a wide variety of goods and grocery items. Rome’s first university, La Sapienza, established in 1303 AD, is the largest in Europe and the second largest in the world. Rome has a museum dedicated entirely to pasta. title: Petra - Walking the Siq to the Treasury - 4K with Captions - March 2022
description: This walking tour of Petra was filmed on Monday March 28th, 2022 starting at 8:40 AM near the entrance of the Siq. The Siq is a natural 1.2 km long sandstone gorge that gently winds toward the ancient city of Petra until it opens on to the magnificent Treasury. The Treasury has been used in several moves including Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. It the movie it served as the final location of the Holy Grail. Along both sides of the Siq are ancient water channels that once held clay pipes that brought fresh water from the Moses Spring into the city of Petra. title: Capri, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer 2024 - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Welcome to our walking tour of Capri! Get ready to explore this beautiful island with us as we wander through its picturesque streets, discover stunning viewpoints, and soak in the unique atmosphere of one of Italy's most beloved destinations. Let’s get started! Timestamps: 0:00:00 Intro 0:05:57 Capri We begin our tour in the heart of Capri. As we stroll through the bustling Piazzetta, you'll see why this lively square is the social hub of the island. We'll walk down charming streets lined with high-end boutiques and local shops, giving you a feel for the island's mix of luxury and local flavor. 1:29:35 Villa Lysis Our next stop is Villa Lysis. We'll walk through the serene pathways leading up to this historic mansion. Once there, you'll get to admire its neoclassical architecture and beautiful gardens. We'll share stories about its intriguing past as we explore its elegant rooms and enjoy the panoramic views it offers. 1:59:14 Walking To The Centre Of Capri Join us as we walk towards the center of Capri. Along the way, we’ll pass by quaint houses adorned with colorful flowers and stop at a few local cafes and shops. This leisurely stroll gives you a taste of the everyday life and the friendly vibe of the island. 2:24:15 Capri With Cloudy Weather Even with cloudy skies, Capri is captivating. As we continue our walk, you’ll see how the island’s beauty is softened and enhanced by the overcast weather. We'll take you to some quieter spots where the peaceful atmosphere adds to the island's charm. 3:31:37 Capri Evening Walk As evening approaches, our walk through Capri becomes even more magical. The streets light up, and there's a romantic glow over the island. We’ll wander through the evening hustle and bustle, with stops at some cozy spots perfect for enjoying the twilight views and the island’s nightlife. 4:32:09 Anacapri Finally, we head to Anacapri, the quieter, more laid-back part of the island. We’ll walk through its charming streets, visit some local artisan shops, and take in the stunning views from this elevated area. Anacapri offers a different perspective of the island, and it's a perfect way to end our tour. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will make sure that you are not on this video anymore.***

title: Amsterdam, Netherlands - Enjoy the Tranquil Streets along the Canal, 4K Walking Tour 🇳🇱
description: Amsterdam is the capital and most populous city of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and ranks 19th among the largest cities in the European Union. The municipality of Amsterdam has 872,922 inhabitants (as of January 1, 2021)and as an agglomeration Groot-Amsterdam 1,394,998 inhabitants (as of March 31, 2021). Amsterdam is located in the Dutch province of North Holland, on the canalized Amstel River and the former IJ estuary. The city's port is connected to the North Sea by the North Sea Canal. Amsterdam is world famous for its canals. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer Evening Walk ☀️ - 4K-HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 My favorite city in the world is Rome. Why? Because it is the ideal marriage of history and modernity. It has it all: beautiful historical sites, incredible shops, and, of course, the best pizzas in the world. So here's my take on Rome and why I love it so much: 1) The individuals The hospitality in Italy is unrivaled. From the moment you meet, the Italians treat you like long-lost friends. The hotel staff is extremely friendly and responds to your complaints quickly. The best thing about Italians, however, is the way they speak. Their language sounds like a lovely song. It's so adorable that even if they were cursing at me, I wouldn't be able to guess. 2) The food If you think you've had the best Italian food in your own country, you're mistaken, my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source...which in this case is Italy (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafés serve the most delectable ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos, and to-die-for pizzas. If I could, I would return to Rome just for the food. 3) The historical importance The history of Rome is divided into two parts. Medieval history and the Roman Empire Each era's architecture is divided into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most beautiful I've ever done. On either side of the path, there are ancient relics. 4) The Vatican This mini-city alone would make a trip to Rome worthwhile. In the Sistine Chapel, the Vatican has some of the most beautiful frescoes ever created. Hundreds of tour guides are available just outside the Vatican to give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure you don't get taken advantage of! 5) Shopping Although Milan is a major fashion capital, Rome is not far behind. The shopping here is fantastic, with everything from boutique brands to mainstream brands available. There is a four-story Zara store nearby (I spent around two hours there I think). After a long day of shopping, you can unwind in a nice spot, eating street-made square pizzas and watching the sun set over the city. This video was recorded in September of 2021! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

description: Vienna, the capital city of Austria, is a cultural and historical hub of Europe. It is renowned for its stunning architecture, rich musical heritage, and artistic legacy. The city's grand boulevards and palaces reflect its imperial past and the Habsburg dynasty's influence, which ruled for more than six centuries. The majestic Schönbrunn Palace, St. Stephen's Cathedral, and the Vienna State Opera are some of the iconic landmarks that add to Vienna's charm. The city's coffeehouses, which originated in the 17th century, are a hub of social life, and the Viennese cuisine is renowned for its rich flavors and fine ingredients. Vienna's vibrant arts scene is home to the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra, the Vienna Boys Choir, and several museums showcasing masterpieces by world-renowned artists such as Gustav Klimt, Egon Schiele, and Oskar Kokoschka. Vienna is also known for its bustling markets, including the Naschmarkt, where visitors can find an array of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and antiques. With its delightful parks, enchanting palaces, and cultural richness, Vienna offers a unique blend of tradition and modernity that continues to fascinate visitors from all over the world. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Rethymno (Ρέθυμνο), Greece 4K-HDR Walking Tour - 2021 - Tourister Tours
description: Rethymno Greece is a laid-back prefecture located between the regions of Chania and Heraklion. Relatively untouched by international tourists, Rethymno still keeps its traditional charm. The video was recorded 28th of June 2021. On the northern side of Rethymno Crete, there are some cosmopolitan seaside resorts, such as Bali, Adelianos, Kampos, Panormos, and Platanias. They are perfect for your stay, as they have a selection of Rethymno hotels and villas. But, if you seek a laid-back place to stay, a drive around Rethymno will get you to many secluded places, such as Agia Galini and Plakias. The center of activities in Rethymnon is Rethymno Old Town. The architecture of Rethymno Town is strongly influenced by the Venetians, who ruled the island in the past. This picturesque town is full of narrow alleys, elegant mansions, arches, and boasts a beautiful Venetian port. The port of Rethymno is hands down the most popular spot of the town! It is lined with cafeterias and restaurants, while the seafront promenade is perfect for evening strolls. Another vestige of the Venetian occupation is Fortezza, an imposing medieval castle that stands on a hill above the town. The northern and southern coasts of Rethymno are fringed with beautiful beaches, such as Bali, Panormos, Adelianos Kampos, Plakias, and Agia Galini. Rethymno beaches are not the only standouts of the region, though. The inland holds many surprises: traditional villages, impressive gorges, and monasteries, such as Preveli and Arkadi. If you want to introduce yourself to the local culture, a visit to the villages of Rethymno is a must! Rethymno is the getaway you’ve been looking for! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will make sure that you are not on this video anymore.***

title: Portofino, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: Portofino is a picturesque fishing village located on the Italian Riviera, in the Liguria region of Italy. Nestled in a small, sheltered bay, Portofino is renowned for its vibrant, pastel-colored houses that line the waterfront, creating a charming and idyllic scene. The village is surrounded by lush, green hills dotted with olive groves and pine trees, offering stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea. The harbor is the focal point of Portofino, bustling with luxurious yachts and small fishing boats. The waterfront is lined with chic cafes, upscale restaurants, and boutique shops, providing a perfect blend of relaxation and sophistication. The narrow, winding streets of the village invite visitors to explore its quaint charm, with historical landmarks such as the Church of St. Martin, the 16th-century Castello Brown, and the lighthouse at Punta del Capo offering glimpses into its rich history. Portofino is also a haven for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts. The surrounding Portofino Regional Park offers numerous hiking trails with breathtaking coastal views, while the clear, turquoise waters of the bay are ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and diving. The area's natural beauty, combined with its elegant ambiance, has made Portofino a popular destination for celebrities and travelers seeking a luxurious escape. Despite its small size, Portofino exudes a timeless appeal, blending the rustic charm of an old fishing village with the allure of a high-end retreat. Whether you're savoring local seafood dishes, exploring the scenic landscapes, or simply soaking in the tranquil atmosphere, Portofino offers a unique and unforgettable experience. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Evening Walk - September 2021 - 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶130min)
description: Rome is my favorite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday!

Ragusa: Explore the stunning baroque architecture and winding streets of Ragusa, one of the jewels of Sicily. This walking tour takes you through the heart of Ragusa Ibla, the historic district, offering a glimpse into the city’s rich history and breathtaking views. We begin with a drone intro, offering sweeping views of the city, followed by a stroll along the Percoso delle Scale, a historic pathway connecting upper and lower Ragusa. Our first stop is the Santa Maria delle Scale, a beautiful church offering panoramic views of the town. As we continue, we pass the Palazzo dell'ex Cancelleria and the striking Chiesa Anime del Purgatorio, both examples of Ragusa’s iconic baroque style. Wandering through the charming streets, we explore Via del Mercato, Via XI Febbraio, and Via Tenente di Stefano before making our way to the grand Piazza Duomo. Here, the magnificent Duomo di San Giorgio, an architectural masterpiece, dominates the square. We take a moment to appreciate the beauty of Palazzo Battaglia and the Circolo di Conversazione, important cultural landmarks of the city. The tour continues along Corso XXV Aprile to the Church of Saint Joseph before we arrive at the serene Giardino Ibleo, a tranquil garden offering stunning views of the surrounding countryside. Our walk concludes with visits to the Chiesa di San Vincenzo Ferreri and the historic Portale di San Giorgio, a remnant of a 14th-century church. History: Ragusa, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is renowned for its baroque architecture, much of which was rebuilt after a devastating earthquake in 1693. The Duomo di San Giorgio, designed by architect Rosario Gagliardi, is one of the finest examples of Sicilian baroque style. Tips: The Giardino Ibleo is perfect for a peaceful break while enjoying the scenic views. Wear comfortable shoes, as the streets are steep and cobblestone. Visit Duomo di San Giorgio in the late afternoon to see it illuminated by the setting sun. #Ragusa #Sicily #Italy #DuomodiSanGiorgio #BaroqueArchitecture #Travel #GiardinoIbleo

title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Piazzas, Fountains, and History - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: ✈️ Follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/toyrister 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Rome, the eternal city, stands as a majestic testament to centuries of history, culture, and civilization. Located in the heart of Italy, along the banks of the Tiber River, Rome is a city where the past and present coalesce seamlessly, offering a captivating blend of ancient ruins, Renaissance architecture, and modern vitality. At its core lies the iconic Roman Forum, once the political, religious, and commercial hub of the mighty Roman Empire. Here, among the towering columns and crumbling temples, visitors can stroll through the remnants of an ancient world, imagining the bustling life that once thrived within these hallowed precincts. Adjacent to the Forum lies perhaps the most enduring symbol of Rome: the Colosseum. This colossal amphitheater, with its grand arches and imposing facade, stands as a testament to the ingenuity and engineering prowess of the ancient Romans. Once the stage for gladiatorial contests and grand spectacles, today it remains a powerful reminder of the city's rich and often tumultuous past. Yet Rome is not merely a city of ancient relics; it is also a vibrant metropolis teeming with life. Narrow cobblestone streets wind through charming neighborhoods, each boasting its own unique character and allure. Piazzas, adorned with elegant fountains and bustling cafes, serve as gathering places for locals and visitors alike, offering a glimpse into the timeless rhythm of Roman life. Of course, no visit to Rome would be complete without exploring its wealth of artistic treasures. The Vatican City, an independent enclave within the city limits, is home to some of the world's most revered masterpieces, including Michelangelo's breathtaking frescoes in the Sistine Chapel and the majestic dome of St. Peter's Basilica. As the sun sets over the city, casting a golden glow upon its ancient monuments, Rome takes on a magical aura, evoking a sense of awe and wonder in all who wander its storied streets. For centuries, it has captivated the hearts and minds of travelers, artists, and dreamers, earning its rightful place as one of the most enchanting cities on Earth. title: Santorini, Greece 🇬🇷 - 4K Walking Tour (▶223min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Santorini is a captivating Greek island nestled in the southern Aegean Sea, renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, charming architecture, and rich history. Formed by a volcanic caldera, the island boasts dramatic cliffs that plunge into the azure waters of the Aegean, creating a picture-perfect backdrop that has made Santorini a favorite among travelers and photographers. The iconic architecture of Santorini is characterized by whitewashed buildings with blue-domed roofs, creating a striking contrast against the deep blue sky and sea. The narrow, winding streets of its main towns, such as Fira and Oia, are lined with charming cafes, boutiques, and traditional Greek tavernas, offering visitors a delightful blend of modern amenities and authentic island life. Santorini's history is as fascinating as its scenery. The island is often associated with the ancient Minoan civilization and the legend of the lost city of Atlantis. Visitors can explore archaeological sites like Akrotiri, a well-preserved ancient city that was preserved in volcanic ash, offering a glimpse into the island's past. The island is renowned for its stunning sunsets, particularly in the village of Oia, where crowds gather every evening to witness the sun dip below the horizon, casting a warm glow over the whitewashed buildings and creating a magical atmosphere. For those seeking relaxation, Santorini offers beautiful beaches with unique volcanic sand, such as the Red Beach and Perissa Beach. The therapeutic hot springs at Palea Kameni, another result of the island's volcanic activity, provide a rejuvenating experience amidst the picturesque surroundings. Whether you're drawn to its captivating history, charming architecture, or mesmerizing landscapes, Santorini stands as a timeless destination that captures the hearts of all who visit, leaving an indelible imprint of its beauty and allure. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer Walk ☀️ - 4K-HDR Walking Tour ~3 Hours
description: Rome is my favorite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday! title: DUBAI MALL Full Walking Tour [4K] World’s Largest Mall | United Arab Emirates 🇦🇪
description: The Dubai Mall Downtown Dubai in the United Arab Emirates is one of the largest shopping centers in the world with 350,000 square meters. The Dubai Mall is located south of the well-known Sheik Zayed Road opened on November 4, 2008 with an initial 600 stores and when completed will house 1200 stores, attracting 37 million visitors per year. The mall also has 120 food and beverage outlets, the world's largest gold souk with 220 stores, an Olympic-size ice rink, a music-controlled fountain, a 24-meter-high water cascade, a fashion show hall, a 22-screen multiplex movie theater, a computer game presentation center, and a supervised children's adventure land. Another attraction of the Dubai Mall is the aquarium, which extends over three floors. The largest tank has a footprint of 51 × 20 meters and is 11 meters high. The largest tank, made of 75-centimeter-thick acrylic glass, contains 33,000 sea animals and fish, including sharks of several species, perches, rays and other reef dwellers, in 10,000 cubic meters of seawater taken from the Persian Gulf. Crocodiles, giant crabs but also seals and penguins are in other smaller basins. A two-meter-high narrow pedestrian tunnel runs through the lower tank, with walls only 19 centimeters thick, which serves to reproduce the natural size of the animals. Since no natural light enters the pool, it has a lighting system with control room for day and night simulation; also automatic feeders and water-saving water circulation and purification technology; the water is kept germ-free with ozone. The Dubai Aquarium and Discovery Center received the Guinness World Record for the largest acrylic screen, as well as for the largest shopping mall aquarium. The Dubai Mall, planned by Emaar Properties, is part of the Downtown Dubai project. title: Rhodes, Greece 🇬🇷 - Greek Summer 4K Walking Tour
description: 🔴 Rhodes is the largest of the Dodecanese islands in Greece, renowned for its rich history, stunning beaches, and vibrant cultural heritage. Located in the southeastern Aegean Sea, the island is often referred to as the "Island of the Knights" due to its historical association with the Knights of Saint John, who left a lasting legacy in the form of medieval castles, forts, and the iconic Palace of the Grand Master in the Old Town of Rhodes. The island's capital, also called Rhodes, is a UNESCO World Heritage site, famous for its well-preserved medieval architecture, narrow cobblestone streets, and ancient city walls. The Old Town offers a journey through time, with its mix of Gothic, Byzantine, and Ottoman influences visible in every corner. Visitors can explore the Street of the Knights, visit the Archaeological Museum housed in a former hospital of the Knights, or relax in the tranquil surroundings of the Mosque of Suleiman. Beyond its historical allure, Rhodes boasts breathtaking natural beauty. The island's coastline is dotted with crystal-clear beaches, ranging from the golden sands of Faliraki to the pebbled shores of Lindos. Lindos itself is a must-see, with its whitewashed houses climbing up the hillside to the ancient Acropolis, offering panoramic views of the Aegean Sea. Rhodes is also home to lush valleys, such as the Valley of the Butterflies, where thousands of butterflies gather during the summer months, creating a unique natural spectacle. The island's interior features rolling hills, vineyards, and olive groves, adding to its rural charm. In addition to its historical and natural attractions, Rhodes is known for its lively atmosphere, with a mix of traditional Greek tavernas, modern cafes, and vibrant nightlife, particularly in the areas of Faliraki and the New Town of Rhodes. Overall, Rhodes offers a perfect blend of history, culture, and natural beauty, making it one of Greece's most beloved destinations. Whether you're interested in exploring ancient ruins, lounging on sun-kissed beaches, or enjoying the local cuisine, Rhodes has something to offer every traveler.

title: Ruins of Pompeii: Walking Tour (With Music)
description: Take a 2-hour walk around the ruins of Pompeii. Pompeii is located near the Bay of Naples. It was destroyed in 79 A.D. when Mt. Vesuvius erupted and covered the city in a blanket of ash. While most Pompeiians had time to flee, over 2,000 people died. Pompeii was rediscovered in 1758 by a group of explorers. The excavation process continues to this today with one-third of the city still waiting to be unearthed. Now the city acts as a window into the ancient past. You can see the streets, buildings, houses and even the remains of the victims, just as they were almost 2,000 years ago. title: Malaga, Spain 🇪🇸 - Summer 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to the vibrant city of Malaga, a hidden gem on Spain's Costa del Sol. Our walking tour will take you through its charming streets, showcasing a blend of rich history, stunning architecture, and modern allure. From the ancient Roman Theatre and the imposing Alcazaba fortress to the birthplace of Pablo Picasso, every corner of Malaga whispers stories of its illustrious past. Stroll through the picturesque streets of the historic center, where you'll encounter lively plazas, bustling markets, and quaint cafes. Discover the grandeur of the Malaga Cathedral, often referred to as "La Manquita," and enjoy the panoramic views from the Gibralfaro Castle. As we guide you through the tour, you'll also experience the vibrant local culture, with street performers, traditional Andalusian cuisine, and friendly locals adding to the city's charm. Don't miss the chance to explore the lush gardens of La Concepción Botanical Gardens and the modern allure of the Pompidou Centre Malaga. Watching this walking tour video promises an immersive experience, offering a taste of Malaga's unique blend of tradition and modernity. Join us to uncover hidden gems, historical landmarks, and the essence of Andalusian life. Whether you're planning a visit or simply exploring from home, this tour will leave you captivated by Malaga's enchanting beauty. title: Ibiza, Spain's 🇪🇸 Party Paradise | 4K-HDR 60fps Walking Tour - 4K-HDR 60fps Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Ibiza, the ultimate paradise for those seeking sun-soaked beaches, vibrant nightlife, and a unique blend of relaxation and excitement. Situated in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of Spain, Ibiza is renowned worldwide for its electrifying energy and stunning natural beauty. In this captivating destination, you'll discover pristine white sand beaches caressed by turquoise waters, where you can unwind and soak up the Mediterranean sun. Explore the famous Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Comte, or Talamanca, each offering a distinct atmosphere and breathtaking coastal vistas. Immerse yourself in the vibrant beach club scene, where world-class DJs spin their tunes and create an atmosphere of pure euphoria. But Ibiza is not just about its picturesque coastline; it also boasts a rich cultural heritage. Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Dalt Vila, the fortified old town of Ibiza, where narrow cobblestone streets wind through medieval architecture. Explore the ancient walls, visit the stunning cathedral, and savor the enchanting views overlooking the island and the shimmering Mediterranean Sea. As the sun sets, Ibiza transforms into a legendary nightlife destination. Experience the pulsating beats and energetic atmosphere of world-famous clubs like Pacha, Amnesia, or Ushuaïa. Dance the night away to the music of internationally acclaimed DJs, creating memories that will last a lifetime. Ibiza also offers a variety of culinary delights to satisfy every palate. From fresh seafood dishes to traditional Spanish tapas and international cuisine, the island's diverse dining scene ensures a culinary adventure like no other. Whether you're seeking relaxation, thrilling adventures, or unforgettable parties, Ibiza has it all. With its stunning natural landscapes, vibrant nightlife, and rich cultural heritage, Ibiza is truly a destination that encapsulates the essence of a dream vacation. description: Follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/eytyxhs 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Take a peaceful winter walk through Tromsø, Norway, the “Gateway to the Arctic.” This snowy 4K HDR walking tour captures the charming streets of the city center during a freezing snowfall. Stroll past Storgata (the main pedestrian street), the colorful harborfront, and views toward the iconic Arctic Cathedral and Tromsø Bridge. title: Seville, Spain 🇪🇸 | September 2023 | 4K-HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Seville, the vibrant capital of Spain's Andalusia region, is a city that effortlessly combines rich history, stunning architecture, and a passionate zest for life. Nestled along the banks of the Guadalquivir River, Seville is a city that captivates visitors with its timeless charm and modern vitality. Historical Legacy: Seville boasts a history that spans over two millennia, and this deep-rooted heritage is proudly displayed throughout the city. The iconic Alcázar of Seville, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, stands as a testament to the city's Moorish past. Its intricate Islamic architecture, lush gardens, and opulent interiors transport visitors to a bygone era. Nearby, the colossal Seville Cathedral, another UNESCO gem, rises in Gothic splendor. Inside, the tomb of Christopher Columbus adds an extra layer of historical significance. Majestic Architecture: Stroll through the historic center, and you'll encounter a breathtaking blend of architectural styles. The twisting streets of the Santa Cruz neighborhood, once the Jewish quarter, are lined with whitewashed buildings adorned with colorful tiles and wrought-iron balconies. The Metropol Parasol, affectionately known as "Las Setas" or "The Mushrooms," is a modern architectural marvel, offering panoramic views of the city from its wavy wooden structure. Flamenco and Festivals: Seville is synonymous with flamenco, the passionate and expressive Spanish art form. Locals and visitors alike can savor the soul-stirring rhythms and emotional performances in intimate tablaos or during the city's numerous festivals, such as the Feria de Abril. This week-long celebration transforms Seville into a spectacle of flamenco, colorful dresses, and horse-drawn carriages, drawing revelers from around the world. Culinary Delights: Spanish cuisine is renowned worldwide, and Seville is no exception. Tapas bars fill the streets, tempting taste buds with an array of mouthwatering small dishes. From succulent Iberian ham and fresh seafood to traditional gazpacho and creamy salmorejo, Seville's gastronomy is a culinary adventure waiting to be explored. Don't forget to sip on a glass of Andalusian sherry or sample the local orange-infused wine. Warm Hospitality: One of the defining characteristics of Seville is the warmth of its people. Sevillanos are known for their friendliness and genuine hospitality, making visitors feel at home in this enchanting city. Whether you're enjoying a lively conversation in a local tavern or joining in a spontaneous dance in the streets during a festival, you'll quickly understand the spirit of Seville. Seville, a city that effortlessly marries its storied past with a vibrant present, invites you to immerse yourself in its rich culture, savor its culinary delights, and feel the heartbeat of Andalusia. It's a destination where history comes alive, passions run deep, and every moment is a celebration of life. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

Information: Join us on a captivating walking tour of Sorano, Italy, often regarded as one of the country's most beautiful hidden villages. Nestled in the heart of Tuscany’s Maremma region, this village is known for its dramatic cliffside location and its ancient stone architecture. Sorano offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and historic charm, making it an ideal destination for travelers seeking an authentic Italian experience. History: Sorano's origins date back over two millennia to the Etruscan civilization, with evidence of its rich heritage still visible today. The village thrived under the rule of the Aldobrandeschi family in the Middle Ages and was later fortified by the powerful Orsini family. Its labyrinth of cobblestone streets, medieval fortresses, and rock-carved dwellings offers a glimpse into its storied past. Key historical landmarks include the imposing Orsini Fortress, built to defend against invaders, and the Masso Leopoldino, an ancient defensive structure offering breathtaking views over the village. Tourist Tips: Wear comfortable shoes, as Sorano’s hilly streets and narrow alleyways require lots of walking. Don’t miss a visit to the Orsini Fortress and its museum to delve deeper into the village’s history. For the best views, climb to the top of the Masso Leopoldino, especially at sunset. Be sure to explore Sorano's natural surroundings, including nearby thermal baths like Terme di Sorano for relaxation after a day of exploring. Plan to spend time enjoying local delicacies, like wild boar and handmade pasta, at traditional trattorias in the village. #Sorano #ItalyWalkingTour #MostBeautifulVillage #HiddenItaly #MedievalItaly #SoranoTuscany #TravelItaly #TuscanyTour #ItalianVillage #HistoricItaly #ProWalkTours

title: Budapest, Hungary 🇭🇺 - The Most Impressive City Of Europe - 4K-HDR 60fps Walking Tour
description: Budapest is the capital city of Hungary, located in the heart of Europe. It is known for its stunning architecture, rich history, and cultural heritage. The city is divided into two parts by the Danube River - Buda on the west bank and Pest on the east bank. Each side has its unique character and attractions, and together they offer a wide range of experiences for visitors. Budapest is famous for its thermal baths, including the Gellert and Szechenyi Baths, which are popular with tourists and locals alike. The city also has several stunning landmarks, such as the Hungarian Parliament Building, Fisherman's Bastion, Buda Castle, and St. Stephen's Basilica, to name a few. These landmarks showcase the city's rich history and architectural heritage. Budapest is also known for its vibrant cultural scene, with numerous museums, galleries, theaters, and concert halls. The city is home to the Hungarian National Museum, the Museum of Fine Arts, and the Hungarian State Opera House, among others. Visitors can also enjoy a wide range of cultural events and festivals, including the Budapest Wine Festival and the Budapest International Documentary Festival. The city is also famous for its culinary scene, with a wide variety of traditional Hungarian dishes to try, such as goulash, chimney cake, and langos. Budapest also has a lively nightlife, with numerous bars, clubs, and music venues. In summary, Budapest offers a unique blend of history, culture, architecture, cuisine, and entertainment, making it a popular destination for travelers and tourists from all over the world. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Palma de Mallorca, Spain 🇪🇸 - SUMMER 2023 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶125min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Palma, Spain - a stunning Mediterranean gem waiting to be explored! Join us on this captivating walking tour as we wander through the enchanting streets of Palma, uncovering its rich history, vibrant culture, and architectural wonders. Our journey begins at the iconic Palma Cathedral, a magnificent Gothic masterpiece that dominates the city's skyline. We'll marvel at its intricate details and soak in breathtaking panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from its vantage point. Strolling along the charming cobblestone lanes, we'll encounter the enchanting labyrinthine alleys of the old town, discovering hidden plazas, quaint cafes, and boutique shops along the way. The scent of orange blossoms fills the air as we explore the lively local markets, offering a glimpse into Palma's gastronomic delights. Our path leads us to the majestic Almudaina Palace, once a Moorish fortress and now the official residence of the Spanish Royal Family during their visits to the island. We'll delve into its rich history, admiring its grand architecture and exquisite gardens. As we continue our adventure, we'll pass by the iconic Bellver Castle, perched atop a hill with commanding views of the city and the Mediterranean coastline. We'll uncover tales of knights, conquerors, and kings that resonate through its ancient walls. No visit to Palma would be complete without immersing ourselves in the vibrant atmosphere of the port. We'll wander along the picturesque marina, lined with luxurious yachts and charming waterfront restaurants. Feel the gentle sea breeze as we take a leisurely stroll along the promenade, basking in the beauty of Palma's coastal allure. Join us on this captivating walking tour of Palma, Spain, and let its timeless beauty and captivating charm capture your heart. Whether you're a history enthusiast, a culture aficionado, or simply seeking an unforgettable experience, Palma has something special to offer everyone. Grab your walking shoes, and let's embark on this memorable journey through the captivating streets of Palma, Spain! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: MEDINA, Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 The Prophet’s City at Night | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Medina night walking tour takes you through the holy city after sunset, capturing the calm, spiritual atmosphere of Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah under the night sky. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this Medina city walk shows quiet streets, soft lighting, and the peaceful rhythm of pilgrims and locals during the night hours. We begin around Masjid an-Nabawi, where the Prophet’s Mosque glows beautifully at night and the courtyards fill with worshippers in a calm and reflective atmosphere. The walk continues through surrounding streets, showing Medina’s nighttime life before reaching Quba Mosque, the first mosque in Islam, experienced under the peaceful night sky. This night walk focuses on serenity, devotion, and the unique feeling of Medina after dark. 🎥 Perfect for those searching for Medina night walking tour 4K, Masjid an-Nabawi night walk, Quba Mosque night visit, Medina city walk, Islamic holy sites at night, or virtual night walks through Saudi Arabia. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🌙 Masjid an-Nabawi – The Prophet’s Mosque illuminated at night 🕌 Mosque Courtyards – Calm worship and night prayers ✨ Medina Streets – Quiet nighttime atmosphere 🛣️ City Walk – Peaceful movement through Medina after dark 🕌 Quba Mosque – The first mosque in the world at night 🕋 Spiritual Mood – Reflection, devotion, and calm city life 📌 About Medina at Night: Medina feels especially peaceful after sunset. The crowds thin out, lights soften the cityscape, and the spiritual character of the city becomes even more present. title: PRAGUE - Czech Republic 🇨🇿 4K Walking Tour | Street Walk | City Tour
description: Prague is the capital and also the most populous city of the Czech Republic. With over 1.3 million inhabitants, Prague ranks thirteenth among the largest cities in the European Union. The historic center of Prague has been recognized by UNESCO as one of the Czech Republic's 14 World Heritage Sites since 1992. Information: Location: Strasbourg, France, known for its blend of French and German cultures, is situated in the Alsace region near the Rhine River. Event: Strasbourg's Christkindelsmärik (Christmas Market) is one of the oldest in Europe, dating back to 1570. Special Features: Over 300 stalls, festive performances, and Alsatian culinary treats like tarte flambée, mulled wine, and bredele (traditional cookies). History: Strasbourg’s Christmas markets are deeply rooted in the city’s history as a former free imperial city of the Holy Roman Empire. The Christkindelsmärik was established to promote Protestant traditions during the Reformation and remains a cornerstone of Alsatian culture. The markets highlight Strasbourg's unique architecture, with timbered houses, cobblestone streets, and grand squares showcasing Gothic, Renaissance, and Baroque styles. Tourist Tips: Timing: Visit in the early evening to enjoy the twinkling holiday lights without the heaviest crowds. Getting Around: Wear comfortable shoes, as the cobblestone streets and bridges require sturdy footwear. Photo Spots: Don’t miss photographing the Strasbourg Cathedral from Rue Mercière and the lights reflecting on the Ill River. Food: Try flammkuchen (tarte flambée) and sip on vin chaud (mulled wine) to stay warm while exploring. #strasbourg #walkingtours #prowalktours
