Nestled along the banks of the Guadalquivir River, Seville is a city that captivates visitors with its timeless charm and modern vitality. Historical Legacy: Seville boasts a history that spans over two millennia, and this deep-rooted heritage is proudly displayed throughout the city. The iconic Alcázar of Seville, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, stands as a testament to the city's Moorish past. Its intricate Islamic architecture, lush gardens, and opulent interiors transport visitors to a bygone era. Nearby, the colossal Seville Cathedral, another UNESCO gem, rises in Gothic splendor. Inside, the tomb of Christopher Columbus adds an extra layer of historical significance. Majestic Architecture: Stroll through the historic center, and you'll encounter a breathtaking blend of architectural styles. The twisting streets of the Santa Cruz neighborhood, once the Jewish quarter, are lined with whitewashed buildings adorned with colorful tiles and wrought-iron balconies. The Metropol Parasol, affectionately known as "Las Setas" or "The Mushrooms," is a modern architectural marvel, offering panoramic views of the city from its wavy wooden structure. Flamenco and Festivals: Seville is synonymous with flamenco, the passionate and expressive Spanish art form. Locals and visitors alike can savor the soul-stirring rhythms and emotional performances in intimate tablaos or during the city's numerous festivals, such as the Feria de Abril. This week-long celebration transforms Seville into a spectacle of flamenco, colorful dresses, and horse-drawn carriages, drawing revelers from around the world. Culinary Delights: Spanish cuisine is renowned worldwide, and Seville is no exception. Tapas bars fill the streets, tempting taste buds with an array of mouthwatering small dishes. From succulent Iberian ham and fresh seafood to traditional gazpacho and creamy salmorejo, Seville's gastronomy is a culinary adventure waiting to be explored. Don't forget to sip on a glass of Andalusian sherry or sample the local orange-infused wine. Warm Hospitality: One of the defining characteristics of Seville is the warmth of its people. Sevillanos are known for their friendliness and genuine hospitality, making visitors feel at home in this enchanting city. Whether you're enjoying a lively conversation in a local tavern or joining in a spontaneous dance in the streets during a festival, you'll quickly understand the spirit of Seville. Seville, a city that effortlessly marries its storied past with a vibrant present, invites you to immerse yourself in its rich culture, savor its culinary delights, and feel the heartbeat of Andalusia. It's a destination where history comes alive, passions run deep, and every moment is a celebration of life. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Seattle Waterfront Ultimate Walking Tour 🇺🇸 New Overlook Walk & Pike Place | 4K60fps
description: Seattle walking tour through Pike Place Market, the new Overlook Walk, Waterfront Park, Pier 62, the Gum Wall, and Elliott Bay — 3.5-mile day walk in Washington, USA. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio. Seattle's waterfront has undergone one of America's most dramatic urban transformations. The Alaskan Way Viaduct that walled off downtown from Elliott Bay for 60+ years is gone, replaced by a 20-acre park system including the elevated Overlook Walk (opened October 2024) and rebuilt Pier 58 (opened July 2025). Ideal for virtual travel, trip planning, treadmill walks, and ambient background atmosphere. Best experienced with headphones. ⭐ Don't miss: The new Overlook Walk at 10:18, Pier 62 at 20:02, the Gum Wall at 1:21:53, the first Starbucks at 1:46:06, and the Pike Place fish throwers at 2:09:03. 📅 Filmed on: Saturday, August 23rd, 2025 | 1:00 PM 🌞 Weather: 29°C | 85°F 📍 Location: Seattle, Washington, USA 📏 Distance: 3.5 Miles 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1nfGjeO7wd1ZGjRNA7gCrm4g5Fx08NGs&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro 0:30 Victor Steinbrueck Park (viewpoint over Elliott Bay) ⭐ 10:18 Overlook Walk (elevated pedestrian bridge, opened 2024) ⭐ 20:02 Pier 62 (rebuilt 2020, first waterfront park piece) 30:55 Seattle Aquarium at Pier 59 31:58 Pier 58 — Waterfront Park (reopened July 2025) 35:58 Pier 57 — Miner's Landing 51:45 Pier 56 55:19 Pier 55 (Argosy Cruises) 56:43 Pier 54 57:32 Ye Olde Curiosity Shop (founded 1899) 1:09:22 Seattle Ferry Terminal (Colman Dock) 1:10:13 The Park Promenade ⭐ 1:21:53 Post Alley — Gum Wall ⭐ 1:26:22 Pike Place Market (outside) 1:39:49 Jonny Hahn — Street Busker ⭐ 1:46:06 The First Starbucks (est. 1977 at this location) 1:51:54 Victor Steinbrueck Park 1:53:05 Emery Carl — Street Busker 1:55:55 New Waterfront View 1:58:53 Post Alley Shops 2:04:17 Pike Place Market (inside) ⭐ 2:09:03 Fish Throwers at Pike Place Fish Market 2:10:53 Pike Place Market (underground) 2:16:56 New Waterfront View ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌊 ABOUT SEATTLE'S WATERFRONT ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ For over 60 years, the double-decker Alaskan Way Viaduct (1953–2019) walled off downtown Seattle from Elliott Bay. After the 2001 Nisqually earthquake exposed its vulnerability, the city replaced it with a deep-bored tunnel and demolished the viaduct in 2019. What rose in its place is the 20-acre Waterfront Park — Seattle's largest civic project since the 1962 World's Fair. The rebuilt Pier 62 opened in 2020, the elevated Overlook Walk connecting Pike Place Market to the waterfront opened in October 2024, and Pier 58 reopened in July 2025 — just weeks before this walk was filmed. Pike Place Market itself has been operating continuously since 1907. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📽 MORE WALKING TOURS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎄 Christmas Markets: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCd2nqHyPaDtgxkf_BsAuQCt&si=0YU1zhv0tLbwm8u6 🍕 Italy: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCc6k7EuMhr764qCNeXDrxpj&si=aYfLAtNw1eGc560w 🏛️ Greece: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCf151n5M3j9IxxvvvZNK7TM&si=xW-ewBTs4pzb90a1 🚴 Biking Tours: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCe4SaQXMk9IMfpkl1w473Zz&si=1rFBHTnZtCMmykPA 🌍 Complete List: http://www.prowalks.com/videos ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📢 SUPPORT & CONNECT 📢 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌍 Website: https://www.prowalktours.com 📧 Email: info@prowalktours.com 🔔 Subscribe for more! title: Venice, Italy 🇮🇹 | Hot Summer Walking Tour 2022 - 4K/60fps HDR
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Venice is one of the world's most beautiful cities. It is made up of over a hundred islands in a lagoon in the northern Adriatic Sea. Venice is a cultural and tourist destination known for its museums, architecture, cityscape, and art world. Only around one-fourth of Venice's 280 000 inhabitants live in the city's historical center. The remainder reside on the mainland. Boats that travel up and down the city's many canals are the primary mode of transportation between the islands. The Canale Grande, which runs through the heart of Venice, is the main waterway. The islands are linked by hundreds of bridges. Motorboats have largely replaced the historic gondolas, which are now only used for sightseeing tours. People either walk or take so-called waterbuses to get around the islands. The Piazza San Marco, also known as Saint Mark's Square, is the heart of Venice. The piazza's main attractions are the city's most famous church, San Marco Basilica, and the Doge's Palace, which served as the residence of Venice's rulers for hundreds of years. The square is a popular tourist destination that is surrounded by cafes and vendors. Lido, a 10-kilometer-long sandy island east of the historic center on the lagoon's rim, attracts thousands of beachgoers during the summer months. The Venice Film Festival is one of the city's major annual film events. Venice has faced numerous challenges as a result of its sea-level location and global warming. The Mediterranean town has been regularly flooded by incoming tides over the centuries. From November to February, they cause acqua alta, which causes sea levels to rise up to 1.5 meters and cover many of Venice's famous areas. To provide pedestrians with a path to walk, wooden walkways must be built. Many buildings' foundations have been damaged by seawater, necessitating ongoing repairs. Water seeps into the buildings, destroying the walls and the priceless frescoes. Industries and tourism have steadily reduced ground water levels in Venice, making building foundations unstable. The islands are sinking at an alarming rate of 3 to 4 mm per year. City planners are working on building a series of steel gates that will hopefully prevent seawater from entering the lagoon. title: ANKARA Kızılay - Türkiye 🇹🇷 4K Walking Tour in most Famous District | Capital of Turkey
description: This walking video was recorded in 4k in Kızılay in Ankara, Türkiye 🇹🇷 Kızılay is a district in central Ankara best known for its commercial and shopping malls. It is named after the Turkish Red Crescent (Kızılay Derneği) Hospital, which is located in this district. The center is Kızılay Meydanı (Kızılay Square). There are many retail and grocery stores on the main street, Atatürk Bulvarı, as well as restaurants and bars with outdoor seating, fish markets and a large flower market. In Kızılay is the Güven Park with many trees and benches, next to a bus station. During protests in Turkey in 2013, Kızılay Square alongside Taksim Square in Istanbul was one of the main gathering places. 🙌 Support with a donation! https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/MediaOZ 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: Positano Evening Walk 🇮🇹 Amalfi Coast Sunset, Old Town & Music on the Rocks | 4K60fps
description: Positano evening walking tour along the Amalfi Coast — golden-hour sunset views, the iconic majolica dome of Santa Maria Assunta, Spiaggia Grande beach, Piazza dei Mulini, and nightlife at Music on the Rocks. A summer evening walk through Positano, Italy, in the Campania region. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio. Clinging to the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast — a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1997 — Positano is one of the most photographed towns in Italy. This walk begins with sunset views from above the pyramid of pastel houses, descends to the Byzantine Black Madonna in the 13th-century church, ends at the beach after dark, and stops at the cliffside nightclub Music on the Rocks. Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones. ⭐ Don't miss: Sunset viewpoint at 0:10, Top of the Pyramid at 13:58, Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta at 54:24, Spiaggia Grande at night at 1:13:52, and Music on the Rocks at 1:18:55. 📅 Filmed on: Sunday, July 2nd, 2023 🌞 Weather: 25°C | 77°F 📍 Location: Positano, Campania, Italy 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1PBpXGiZ4LILO9nuc5Y-cx2B6PHNzVt8&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro ⭐ 0:10 Sunset Viewpoint 1:50 Dinner Along Viale Pasitea 10:59 Scenic Dinner Location ⭐ 13:58 Top of the Pyramid 28:52 Outdoor Shopping 34:04 BlueStarPositano at Piazza dei Mulini 34:38 Via Cristoforo Colombo 40:13 Dinner with Pyramid View 41:28 Scenic Viewpoint 49:49 Via dei Mulini ⭐ 54:24 Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta 58:03 Shops by the Beach 1:02:52 Dinner Along the Water 1:04:23 Ferry Port 1:11:04 Chez Black ⭐ 1:13:52 Spiaggia Grande at Night ⭐ 1:18:55 Music on the Rocks Nightclub 1:21:24 Nightclub View 1:24:41 Beachfront Promenade 1:27:22 Walk Back Up 1:33:33 Piazza dei Mulini 1:34:28 Camera Setup ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⛪ ABOUT POSITANO ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Legend says Positano takes its name from a Byzantine icon of the Black Madonna being transported by Saracen pirates around the 10th century. When a storm stranded their ship, sailors heard a voice calling "Posa, posa" — "put me down." They brought the icon ashore, the storm calmed, and the town grew around the spot. That 13th-century icon still hangs above the altar of Chiesa di Santa Maria Assunta, visited at 54:24, under its famous dome of yellow, green, and blue majolica tiles. description: This 4K Antalya walking tour takes you through the vibrant city center and the historic heart of the Mediterranean coast, capturing modern streets, ancient ruins, panoramic viewpoints, and waterfront scenery. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this Antalya city walk shows the authentic rhythm of daily life mixed with centuries of history. The walk includes Kazım Özalp Street, the city’s main pedestrian shopping street, as well as the Antalya Clock Tower and Cumhuriyet Street, two of the most recognizable landmarks in the city center. You’ll see the Old Bazaar and traditional market atmosphere, along with ancient city walls and ruins that reflect Antalya’s long history. The route also features Republic Square and the Mustafa Kemal Atatürk Monument, important public spaces in the city. Historic Kaleiçi Old Town plays a major role in this walk, with narrow streets, Ottoman-era houses, cafés, and small shops. The iconic Yivliminare Mosque stands as one of Antalya’s key symbols, while the Kaleiçi panoramic viewpoint offers scenic views over the city and coastline. The tour also includes Antalya Marina, Mermerli Beach, and port viewpoints overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. Finally, modern Antalya comes into focus again around MarkAntalya Shopping Mall, highlighting the city’s contemporary side. 🎥 Perfect for those searching for Antalya walking tour 4K, Antalya city walk, Kaleiçi Old Town walk, Antalya Marina walk, Yivliminare Mosque, Antalya Clock Tower, Kazım Özalp Street, or virtual walking tours through Turkey. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🚶 Kazım Özalp Street – Main shopping and pedestrian street 🕰️ Antalya Clock Tower & Cumhuriyet Street – Historic city center 🛍️ Old Bazaar – Traditional market atmosphere 🏛️ Ancient City Walls & Ruins – Layers of history 🇹🇷 Mustafa Kemal Atatürk Monument – Central public square 🌅 Kaleiçi Panoramic Viewpoint – Scenic city and sea views 🕌 Yivliminare Mosque – Iconic Seljuk-era landmark 🏘️ Kaleiçi Old Town – Narrow streets and Ottoman houses ⚓ Antalya Marina – Waterfront and harbor atmosphere 🌊 Mermerli Beach & Port Viewpoint – Mediterranean coastline 🏬 MarkAntalya – Modern shopping center 📌 About Antalya: Antalya is one of Turkey’s most diverse cities, blending ancient history, Ottoman architecture, Mediterranean coastline, and modern urban life. From Kaleiçi Old Town to bustling shopping streets and seaside viewpoints, the city offers a rich and varied walking experience. This 4K Antalya walking tour captures both historic charm and contemporary city life naturally, with real street sounds and an immersive atmosphere. 🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Antalya, Turkey 🇹🇷 📽️ Format: 4K at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️🌆 Time: Day & Evening Which part of this Antalya walking tour would you enjoy most – exploring Kaleiçi Old Town, walking along the marina, or discovering the lively streets of the city center? 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer Walk ☀️ - 4K-HDR Walking Tour ~5 Hours
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 My favorite city in the world is Rome. Why? Because it is the ideal marriage of history and modernity. It has it all: beautiful historical sites, incredible shops, and, of course, the best pizzas in the world. So here's my take on Rome and why I love it so much: 1) The individuals The hospitality in Italy is unrivaled. From the moment you meet, the Italians treat you like long-lost friends. The hotel staff is extremely friendly and responds to your complaints quickly. The best thing about Italians, however, is the way they speak. Their language sounds like a lovely song. It's so adorable that even if they were cursing at me, I wouldn't be able to guess. 2) The food If you think you've had the best Italian food in your own country, you're mistaken, my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source...which in this case is Italy (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafés serve the most delectable ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos, and to-die-for pizzas. If I could, I would return to Rome just for the food. 3) The historical importance The history of Rome is divided into two parts. Medieval history and the Roman Empire Each era's architecture is divided into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most beautiful I've ever done. On either side of the path, there are ancient relics. 4) The Vatican This mini-city alone would make a trip to Rome worthwhile. In the Sistine Chapel, the Vatican has some of the most beautiful frescoes ever created. Hundreds of tour guides are available just outside the Vatican to give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure you don't get taken advantage of! 5) Shopping Although Milan is a major fashion capital, Rome is not far behind. The shopping here is fantastic, with everything from boutique brands to mainstream brands available. There is a four-story Zara store nearby (I spent around two hours there I think). After a long day of shopping, you can unwind in a nice spot, eating street-made square pizzas and watching the sun set over the city. This video was recorded in September of 2021! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: Otranto, Italy 4K Walking Tour | Beautiful Old Town & Turquoise Sea
description: This 4K walking tour of Otranto, Italy was filmed on Sunday, July 19th, 2026 starting at 12:34 PM at the Spiaggetta del Molo, the little beach at the foot of the town walls. It was a hot market Sunday — 31°C (88°F), with the monthly Otranto Antiqua antiques market running all day along the waterfront — so the whole town was either at the beach or in the water. The 5 km (3 mile) route circles the beaches, the walled old town, the Cathedral with its famous 12th-century Tree of Life floor mosaic and the Chapel of the 800 Martyrs, the Aragonese Castle, the Byzantine church of San Pietro, and ends on the long sandy beaches across the bay. title: Liverpool, England - Evening Walk - 4K Walking Tour (▶156min)
description: ✈️ Follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/toyrister 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Nestled in the northwest of England, Liverpool stands as a city that beckons with its unique amalgamation of history, music, and warm hospitality. As the birthplace of The Beatles, one of the most influential bands in the annals of music, Liverpool boasts a rich cultural legacy. The city resonates with the tunes of its iconic past, inviting visitors to explore the Beatles Story museum and experience the vibrant ambiance of Mathew Street, home to the legendary Cavern Club. Beyond its musical prominence, Liverpool's UNESCO-listed waterfront paints a picturesque scene, blending historic architecture with modern structures. The Royal Albert Dock stands as a testament to the city's maritime heritage, hosting an array of shops, restaurants, and attractions, including the Tate Liverpool. The architectural tapestry of Liverpool is equally compelling, showcasing landmarks such as St. George's Hall, the Liver Building, and the cathedrals that grace its skyline. Football fervor runs deep in Liverpool, home to the illustrious Liverpool FC and Everton FC. Anfield and Goodison Park offer not just stadiums but an immersion into the passion and history of English football. Yet, beyond its cultural and sporting allure, what truly distinguishes Liverpool is the warmth and friendliness of its people. The locals, known for their welcoming spirit, contribute to the city's vibrant atmosphere, creating an environment that embraces every visitor. Liverpool, with its rich cultural heritage, iconic landmarks, and a community spirit, stands as an enriching destination that promises a memorable and immersive experience for those who venture into its dynamic embrace.

title: Miami South Beach Evening Walking Tour 🌴 Ocean Drive, Española Way & Lummus Park | 4K Night Walk
description: *An evening walk through Miami's South Beach* — one of the most iconic nightlife destinations in the world. This tour starts at Lummus Park on the oceanfront, heads up the famous neon-lit Ocean Drive past Art Deco hotels and sidewalk cafes, detours through the charming pastel streets of Española Way, and returns along Ocean Drive as the night crowd fills in. Filmed during Spring Break 2025 — the energy speaks for itself. 📅 *Filmed on* Saturday, March 15th, 2025 | 7:11 PM 🌞 *Weather* 25°C | 77°F 📍 *Location:* Miami Beach, Florida, USA 📏 *Distance:* 2.6 Miles 🗺️ *Map of the Walk* https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/0/edit?mid=1Jbt7Wwxhi2dMNKK7nChwzvSKRR4zePA&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ *TOUR TIMELINE* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro and Map 0:53 Lummus Park 12:15 Ocean Drive 43:39 Betsy Orb 45:18 Española Way 1:05:32 Ocean Drive ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🏛️ *ABOUT SOUTH BEACH* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Ocean Drive is the heart of Miami Beach's Art Deco Historic District — a mile-long stretch of pastel-colored hotels and restaurants built largely in the 1930s and 1940s. The district contains one of the largest concentrations of Art Deco architecture in the world and was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1979. Lummus Park, running parallel to the beach, is one of Miami's oldest parks and the social center of the South Beach oceanfront. Española Way, developed in 1925 as a Mediterranean Revival village, was originally envisioned as an artists' colony and is now one of the most photographed side streets in the city. title: Paros, Greece 🇬🇷 - The Quieter Mykonos - 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Paros, nestled in the heart of the Aegean Sea within the Cyclades island group, offers a blend of traditional Greek charm and serene landscapes. Renowned for its stunning beaches such as Golden Beach and Kolymbithres, the island is a haven for both sun seekers and water sports enthusiasts. Paros also boasts an impressive historical legacy, evidenced by landmarks like the Panagia Ekatontapiliani, a historic Byzantine church that dates back to the 4th century. The island's villages, including the picturesque Naoussa and Parikia, are characterized by narrow, winding streets, white-washed houses, and vibrant bougainvillea—a classic Cycladic setting. These towns are not only visual treats but also cultural hubs with a variety of shops, cafes, and tavernas that offer a taste of local life and cuisine. Paros also serves as a cultural crossroads, hosting numerous art exhibitions, festivals, and local celebrations which add to its lively yet laid-back atmosphere. It's a place where visitors can easily blend into the local way of life, enjoying the leisurely pace and warm hospitality of its residents. For travelers seeking a mix of relaxation, adventure, and cultural immersion, Paros stands out as a less commercialized alternative to its more famous neighbor, Mykonos, providing a more authentic and tranquil Greek island experience.

title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - October 2022 - 4K-HDR 60fps Walking Tour
description: 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 My favorite city in the world is Rome. Why? Because it is the ideal marriage of history and modernity. It has it all: beautiful historical sites, incredible shops, and, of course, the best pizzas in the world. So here's my take on Rome and why I love it so much: 1) The individuals The hospitality in Italy is unrivaled. From the moment you meet, the Italians treat you like long-lost friends. The hotel staff is extremely friendly and responds to your complaints quickly. The best thing about Italians, however, is the way they speak. Their language sounds like a lovely song. It's so adorable that even if they were cursing at me, I wouldn't be able to guess. 2) The food If you think you've had the best Italian food in your own country, you're mistaken, my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source...which in this case is Italy (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafés serve the most delectable ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos, and to-die-for pizzas. If I could, I would return to Rome just for the food. 3) The historical importance The history of Rome is divided into two parts. Medieval history and the Roman Empire Each era's architecture is divided into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most beautiful I've ever done. On either side of the path, there are ancient relics. 4) The Vatican This mini-city alone would make a trip to Rome worthwhile. In the Sistine Chapel, the Vatican has some of the most beautiful frescoes ever created. Hundreds of tour guides are available just outside the Vatican to give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure you don't get taken advantage of! 5) Shopping Although Milan is a major fashion capital, Rome is not far behind. The shopping here is fantastic, with everything from boutique brands to mainstream brands available. There is a four-story Zara store nearby (I spent around two hours there I think). After a long day of shopping, you can unwind in a nice spot, eating street-made square pizzas and watching the sun set over the city. We begin at Alexanderplatz, Berlin’s busy square with its famous TV Tower. From there, we head towards Hackescher Markt, passing along Dircksenstrasse and the train line before arriving at one of the city’s most vibrant districts. The walk continues through Rosenthaler Straße and into the famous Hackesche Höfe – a maze of beautifully restored courtyards full of cafés, shops, and galleries. The tour ends with more views around Hackescher Markt and a glimpse of everyday East Berlin atmosphere before returning to Alexanderplatz. 🎥 Perfect for those searching for Berlin walking tour 4K, Alexanderplatz Berlin walk, Hackescher Markt tour, Hackesche Höfe Berlin, East Berlin city walk, or virtual walks through Germany’s capital. 📍 Tour Highlights: 🌆 Alexanderplatz – Central square with TV Tower & city vibes 🚉 Dircksenstraße – Walking along Berlin’s elevated train line 🍽️ Hackescher Markt – Restaurants, nightlife, and street culture 🛍️ Rosenthaler Straße – Shops, cafés, and urban atmosphere 🏘️ Hackesche Höfe – Famous courtyards with art, cafés & boutiques ✨ East Berlin Feeling – Everyday life, architecture & street scenes 📌 About Berlin Mitte: Berlin Mitte is the historic heart of Germany’s capital, combining famous landmarks with lively neighborhoods. Alexanderplatz is one of Berlin’s busiest hubs, while Hackescher Markt and the Hackesche Höfe offer a vibrant mix of culture, history, and modern city life. title: Genoa, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer 2024 - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Genoa, a port city and the capital of the Liguria region in northwest Italy, is known for its rich maritime history and stunning architecture. Situated on the Ligurian Sea, Genoa has been a significant seaport since ancient times. The city is famed for its narrow, winding streets in the old town, called "caruggi," which lead to charming squares and historic buildings. Key landmarks include the Genoa Cathedral, the Palazzo Ducale, and the iconic Lanterna, a lighthouse symbolizing the city. Genoa is also the birthplace of Christopher Columbus, and the city's maritime museum pays homage to its naval heritage. The city boasts beautiful palaces along Via Garibaldi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, showcasing Genoa's wealth and influence during the Renaissance. With its vibrant cultural scene, delicious Ligurian cuisine, and scenic coastal views, Genoa offers a blend of history, art, and Mediterranean charm. This video was recorded in June of 2024. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will make sure that you are not on this video anymore.***

description: *A full afternoon walk along Miami Beach during Spring Break* — starting at South Pointe Park Pier at the southern tip of the island, heading north along the beach through Lummus Park, up Ocean Drive past the Art Deco hotels, through the charming Española Way village, and back down to South Pointe for golden hour. Ocean Drive runs through the heart of Miami Beach's Art Deco Historic District — a mile-long corridor of 1930s and 1940s hotels listed on the National Register of Historic Places, making it one of the largest Art Deco concentrations in the world. Lummus Park, running between Ocean Drive and the beach, is the social spine of South Beach and home to the iconic painted lifeguard towers. title: EDINBURGH, SCOTLAND 🇬🇧 — ROYAL MILE TO PRINCESS STREET WALKING TOUR | 4K HDR 60FPS
description: Edinburgh is not a city you simply visit; it is a city that enters your bones. From the very first step upon its cobblestones, you feel centuries pressing close around you, as though every street, every shadow, every stone arch is whispering secrets of kings, poets, rebels, and dreamers. This walk, through the heart of Scotland’s capital, is more than a journey on foot — it is a passage through time and imagination, carried forward by the rhythm of footsteps, the echo of bagpipes, and the sheer weight of history. We begin on Princes Street, where the city stretches wide, modern stores on one side, but on the other — a skyline like no other. Rising proudly is the Scott Monument, a dark, spired tribute to Sir Walter Scott, towering above the gardens like a gothic sentinel. Beneath it, the Princes Street Gardens spread in green silence, once a loch, now a resting place for flowers, benches, and the weary traveler pausing to look upwards at Edinburgh Castle, perched defiantly upon its volcanic rock. Few cities in the world open with such drama. As we move forward, the soundscape changes. The hum of buses fades, replaced by a lone bagpiper filling the air with a tune that seems older than the city itself. And soon, we step into the Royal Mile — the spine of Old Town, a street where every building seems to lean inward, huddling together like old storytellers eager to share their tales. Cobbled underfoot, lined with stone facades and crooked chimneys, the Royal Mile is Edinburgh’s heartbeat. Here, we encounter St Giles’ Cathedral, crowned with its remarkable lantern spire. Inside, stained glass catches the Scottish light in hues of blue and red, but even from the street, the cathedral commands reverence. Just a few steps away lies the Heart of Midlothian, a mosaic on the pavement where locals spit for luck — a custom strange to outsiders but rooted deep in the city’s history of defiance. We wander deeper into the Mile, and with every side alley, or “close,” the city reveals hidden chambers of its soul. Some closes are narrow and steep, barely wide enough for two shoulders, but each has a story: merchants, murders, revolutions, and whispers of the supernatural. Edinburgh is a city where the past does not stay silent; it rises like mist from the stones. At Victoria Street, color explodes. Curved like a painter’s brushstroke, this rainbow row of shops and cafes bends down toward the Grassmarket. Its vibrant windows are a modern joy, but beneath lies a darker memory: for centuries, this was the site of public executions. Today, life bustles where death once lingered — pubs overflow with laughter, students gather, and the smell of ale and food rises into the air. And there, looking upward, the Castle dominates everything, looming above as if to remind every soul that power, once, was measured in stone walls and cannon fire. Walking closer, we climb toward its gates. Tourists queue to enter, but from the outside alone it is spectacular — ramparts etched against the sky, flags fluttering, the rock itself a throne for Scotland’s past. From here, the view sweeps out over the city: the Firth of Forth shimmering in the distance, the jagged hills beyond, and the geometric grace of New Town stretching below. Crossing into New Town, the city transforms. Gone are the medieval tangles of narrow closes; here are broad Georgian streets, symmetries of elegance and light. Squares like Charlotte Square and St Andrew Square unfold in stately perfection, built for an age of Enlightenment thinkers, architects, and visionaries. It is here that the dual soul of Edinburgh reveals itself: one half medieval mystery, the other half Georgian order. Together, they balance each other like day and night. Yet no walk through Edinburgh would be complete without stepping into its quiet corners of remembrance. At Greyfriars Kirkyard, the stones lean at odd angles, covered with moss, their inscriptions weathered by centuries of rain and wind. Among them rests the tale of Greyfriars Bobby, the loyal dog who guarded his master’s grave for fourteen years. Tourists smile at his statue, but standing here, among the crooked graves and carved skulls, one feels the deeper truth — that love, loyalty, and memory cling just as strongly to this city as stone and story. ***Friendly Note: Hi there! title: Krakow, Poland 🇵🇱 - Summer 🌞 Walking Tour 4K-HDR (▶177 min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Krakow, a city that effortlessly combines historical grandeur with a vibrant contemporary spirit. Located in southern Poland, Krakow is a captivating destination renowned for its rich history, remarkable architecture, and warm hospitality. Step into the heart of Krakow's Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and you'll be transported back in time. Wander through the bustling Market Square, one of Europe's largest medieval squares, lined with colorful merchant houses, charming cafes, and the iconic Cloth Hall. Marvel at the exquisite Gothic architecture of St. Mary's Basilica, where the sound of the bugle call resonates through the air, a tradition that has endured for centuries. Discover the somber yet poignant history of Krakow at the Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial and Museum, a stark reminder of the atrocities committed during World War II. Pay your respects at this solemn site and gain a deeper understanding of the past. Venture further into the city and find yourself immersed in the enchanting atmosphere of Kazimierz, the historic Jewish Quarter. Explore its narrow streets adorned with synagogues, quirky shops, and trendy bars, where history and modernity harmoniously coexist. Visit the Remuh Synagogue, stroll along Plac Nowy, and experience the vibrant nightlife that has made Kazimierz a cultural hotspot. For art enthusiasts, Krakow offers a wealth of museums and galleries. Explore the fascinating collections at the National Museum, including works by Polish masters such as Stanislaw Wyspianski and Jacek Malczewski. title: Naples, Italy 🇮🇹 - Summer 2024 - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Naples, known as Napoli in Italian, is a vibrant city located in the southern part of Italy. It is the capital of the Campania region and one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, with a rich history dating back to the second millennium BC. The city is renowned for its picturesque coastline, historic architecture, and cultural treasures. One of Naples' most iconic landmarks is the historic city center, which is a UNESCO World Heritage site. This area is a labyrinth of narrow, winding streets filled with ancient churches, grand palaces, and bustling markets. Among these historical gems is the Naples Cathedral, also known as the Cathedral of San Gennaro, which houses the relics of the city's patron saint. Naples is also famous for its proximity to Mount Vesuvius, the still-active volcano that famously erupted in AD 79, burying the nearby cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum. These archaeological sites offer a fascinating glimpse into ancient Roman life and are among the most visited attractions in Italy. Culinary delights are a significant part of Naples' charm. The city is the birthplace of pizza, with the traditional Neapolitan pizza being a must-try. Naples' cuisine also features a variety of seafood dishes, pasta, and pastries, with sfogliatella and babà being local favorites. The city's vibrant street life, lively piazzas, and rich artistic heritage contribute to its unique atmosphere. Naples is home to several important museums and art galleries, such as the Naples National Archaeological Museum, which houses one of the most extensive collections of Greco-Roman artifacts in the world, and the Capodimonte Museum, renowned for its impressive collection of Renaissance and Baroque art. Despite its chaotic traffic and some areas of urban decay, Naples remains a city of immense charm and character, offering visitors a blend of ancient history, stunning landscapes, and a lively cultural scene. Its warm climate, friendly locals, and vibrant festivals make it a captivating destination for travelers seeking an authentic Italian experience. description: This 4K Istanbul walking tour takes you through some of the most famous districts and historic landmarks of Istanbul, Türkiye, connecting elegant modern neighborhoods with the heart of the city’s Old Town. The walk begins in Nişantaşı, one of Istanbul’s most elegant and modern districts, known for its luxury boutiques, stylish cafés, and beautiful European-style streets. From here, the route moves toward the historic center of the city, where centuries of history come together in the Old Town. We arrive in Sultanahmet, the historic heart of Istanbul, home to some of the most famous landmarks in Türkiye. Here you’ll see the legendary Hagia Sophia (Ayasofya-i Kebir Mosque), a masterpiece of Byzantine and Ottoman architecture, along with the surrounding historic squares and streets that form the core of the ancient city. Continuing through the Old City, the walk explores the world-famous Grand Bazaar (Kapalı Çarşı), one of the oldest and largest covered markets in the world, filled with traditional shops, colorful corridors, and centuries-old trading culture. The route then leads to the Egyptian Bazaar (Spice Bazaar / Mısır Çarşısı), known for its vibrant spices, sweets, and traditional Turkish products. Near the waterfront, we explore Eminönü, one of Istanbul’s busiest districts, where ferries cross the Bosphorus and the Golden Horn. The walk finishes across the bridge in Karaköy, a lively neighborhood filled with cafés, historic buildings, and modern city energy. title: GIRESUN - Türkiye 🇹🇷 4K Walking Tour City Center | Travel at the Black Sea
description: This walking video was recorded in 4k in Giresun, Turkey 🇹🇷 Giresun is a province of Turkey. It is located in north-east Turkey on the Black Sea. It has borders with the following provinces: Trabzon in the east, Gümüşhane in the south-east, Erzincan in the south, Sivas in the south and south-west, and Ordu in the west. The Black Sea forms the natural border to the north. Typical for the entire eastern Black Sea coast of Turkey are the mountain ranges and mountains of the Pontus Mountains, which reach down to the Black Sea coast. The region is known for this impressive landscape, not only in Turkey. Flat areas in the city of Giresun can only be found on the narrow coastal strip and between the two river courses and estuaries of the Batlama and Aksu Deresi. About two kilometers off the coast of Giresun is the small island of Giresun Adası (Aretias). According to Greek mythology, Heracles is said to have met the Amazons on this island. title: BERLIN, Germany 🇩🇪 4K Walking Tour | Berlin is getting warm ☀️
description: This walking video was recorded in 4k in Berlin, the capital of Germany 🇩🇪 Berlin is the capital and a state of the Federal Republic of Germany. With about 3.7 million inhabitants, the city is the most populous and, with 892 square kilometers, the largest municipality in Germany, as well as the most populous city in the European Union. The city has the third highest population density in Germany with 4108 inhabitants per square kilometer. Nearly 4.7 million inhabitants live in the Berlin agglomeration, and about 6.2 million in the Berlin-Brandenburg capital region. Berlin is considered a world city of culture, politics, media and science. The local universities and research institutions, local sports and museums enjoy an international reputation. The metropolis holds the UNESCO title of City of Design and is one of the continent's most visited centers. Its architecture, festivities and nightlife are world-renowned. After the end of World War II, the city was subject to a four-power status in 1945; East Berlin functioned as the capital of the socialist German Democratic Republic from 1949, while West Berlin was closely aligned with the liberal-democratic Federal Republic. With the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 and German reunification in 1990, the two halves of the city grew together again and Berlin regained its role as the all-German capital. Since 1999, the city has been the seat of the Federal Government, the Federal President, the German Bundestag, the Bundesrat, as well as most federal ministries, numerous federal agencies and embassies. title: Rhodes, Greece 🇬🇷 - Greek Summer 4K Walking Tour
description: 🔴 Rhodes is the largest of the Dodecanese islands in Greece, renowned for its rich history, stunning beaches, and vibrant cultural heritage. Located in the southeastern Aegean Sea, the island is often referred to as the "Island of the Knights" due to its historical association with the Knights of Saint John, who left a lasting legacy in the form of medieval castles, forts, and the iconic Palace of the Grand Master in the Old Town of Rhodes. The island's capital, also called Rhodes, is a UNESCO World Heritage site, famous for its well-preserved medieval architecture, narrow cobblestone streets, and ancient city walls. The Old Town offers a journey through time, with its mix of Gothic, Byzantine, and Ottoman influences visible in every corner. Visitors can explore the Street of the Knights, visit the Archaeological Museum housed in a former hospital of the Knights, or relax in the tranquil surroundings of the Mosque of Suleiman. Beyond its historical allure, Rhodes boasts breathtaking natural beauty. The island's coastline is dotted with crystal-clear beaches, ranging from the golden sands of Faliraki to the pebbled shores of Lindos. Lindos itself is a must-see, with its whitewashed houses climbing up the hillside to the ancient Acropolis, offering panoramic views of the Aegean Sea. Rhodes is also home to lush valleys, such as the Valley of the Butterflies, where thousands of butterflies gather during the summer months, creating a unique natural spectacle. The island's interior features rolling hills, vineyards, and olive groves, adding to its rural charm. In addition to its historical and natural attractions, Rhodes is known for its lively atmosphere, with a mix of traditional Greek tavernas, modern cafes, and vibrant nightlife, particularly in the areas of Faliraki and the New Town of Rhodes. Overall, Rhodes offers a perfect blend of history, culture, and natural beauty, making it one of Greece's most beloved destinations. Whether you're interested in exploring ancient ruins, lounging on sun-kissed beaches, or enjoying the local cuisine, Rhodes has something to offer every traveler.

title: Santorini, Greece 🇬🇷 - A Luxurious Greek Paradise - 4k HDR 60fps Walking Tour (▶150min)
description: ✈️ Follow me on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/toyrister 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to Support Tourister: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Santorini is a captivating Greek island nestled in the southern Aegean Sea, renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, charming architecture, and rich history. Formed by a volcanic caldera, the island boasts dramatic cliffs that plunge into the azure waters of the Aegean, creating a picture-perfect backdrop that has made Santorini a favorite among travelers and photographers. The iconic architecture of Santorini is characterized by whitewashed buildings with blue-domed roofs, creating a striking contrast against the deep blue sky and sea. The narrow, winding streets of its main towns, such as Fira and Oia, are lined with charming cafes, boutiques, and traditional Greek tavernas, offering visitors a delightful blend of modern amenities and authentic island life. Santorini's history is as fascinating as its scenery. The island is often associated with the ancient Minoan civilization and the legend of the lost city of Atlantis. Visitors can explore archaeological sites like Akrotiri, a well-preserved ancient city that was preserved in volcanic ash, offering a glimpse into the island's past. The island is renowned for its stunning sunsets, particularly in the village of Oia, where crowds gather every evening to witness the sun dip below the horizon, casting a warm glow over the whitewashed buildings and creating a magical atmosphere. For those seeking relaxation, Santorini offers beautiful beaches with unique volcanic sand, such as the Red Beach and Perissa Beach. The therapeutic hot springs at Palea Kameni, another result of the island's volcanic activity, provide a rejuvenating experience amidst the picturesque surroundings. Whether you're drawn to its captivating history, charming architecture, or mesmerizing landscapes, Santorini stands as a timeless destination that captures the hearts of all who visit, leaving an indelible imprint of its beauty and allure.

title: Walk the Path of the Lemons: Maiori to Minori on the Amalfi Coast | June 2025
description: Join me on this beautiful summer walk along Italy’s stunning Amalfi Coast. This walking tour begins on the east end of Maiori on Sunday, June 15th, 2025, at 11:54 AM. We stroll along the beach and the scenic Lungomare before turning up Corso Reginna, Maiori’s charming main street. From there, we ascend the Path of the Lemons (Sentiero dei Limoni)—a historic hillside trail lined with terraced lemon groves offering panoramic views of the sea. After descending into the seaside town of Minori, we explore its streets, beach, and waterfront before making our way back to Maiori via the Amalfi Drive, one of the most iconic coastal roads in the world. The walk ends with a peaceful stretch along Maiori’s eastern beach and a visit to the town’s pier. title: Rome, Italy 🇮🇹 - Evening Walk 🌇- 4K-HDR Walking Tour ~2 Hours
description: Rome is my favorite city in the world. Why? Because it’s the perfect blend of history and the modern world. It has it all- beautiful historical sites, amazing shops and of course; the perfect pizzas ever. So here’s my experience of Rome and why it’s soo awesome: 1) The people Italian hospitality is unbeatable. The Italians treat you like long lost buddies right from the moment you first meet. The hotel staff are extra nice and attend to your complaints within seconds. But the best about Italians is the way they speak. Their language comes out like a sweet song. It so adorbs that I wouldn’t be able to guess even if they were swearing at me. 2) The food If you think you have eaten the best Italian food ever in your own countries, you’re gravely mistaken my friend. The best Italian food comes from the source…which would be Italy in this case (well obviously). These Italian restaurants/cafe’s serve the most scrumptious ravioli, epic mouth-watering risottos and pizzas to die for. I would make a trip back to Rome simply for the food if I could. 3) The historical significance Rome’s history is divided into two parts. The Roman Empire and Medieval history. The architecture of each era is spread out into two distinct areas. The walk to the Colosseum is one of the most enchanting walks I have ever taken. There are ancient relics on either side of the pathway adding to the charm. The Medieval historical sites give off a very “Game of Thrones” vibe. 4) The Vatican This mini-city on its own would make a trip to Rome worth-it. The Vatican some of the most beautiful frescos ever in the Sistine Chapel. You will find hundreds of tour guides right outside the Vatican who will give you a tour of the church and museum. Just make sure that you don’t get ripped off! 5) The shopping Milan is technically a major fashion capital but Rome isn’t far behind. The shopping here is marvelous from boutique brands to mainstream brands. There’s a Zara store that’s four stories high (I spent around two hours there I think). After a day of hard-core shopping you can relax in a nice spot, having street-made square pizzas and watch the sun setting over the beautiful historical ruins. Bliss! Fun Fact: The Trevi Fountain– a must see site- has magical powers. Apparently whoever puts a coin in there is sure to come back to Rome one day. My mom put the coin twice and has visited Rome twice ever since. I put it as well and I sure do hope to go again someday! title: Venice, Italy 🇮🇹 - Evening Walk July 2022- 4K/60fps HDR - Walking Tour
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Venice is one of the world's most beautiful cities. It is made up of over a hundred islands in a lagoon in the northern Adriatic Sea. Venice is a cultural and tourist destination known for its museums, architecture, cityscape, and art world. Only around one-fourth of Venice's 280 000 inhabitants live in the city's historical center. The remainder reside on the mainland. Boats that travel up and down the city's many canals are the primary mode of transportation between the islands. The Canale Grande, which runs through the heart of Venice, is the main waterway. The islands are linked by hundreds of bridges. Motorboats have largely replaced the historic gondolas, which are now only used for sightseeing tours. People either walk or take so-called waterbuses to get around the islands. The Piazza San Marco, also known as Saint Mark's Square, is the heart of Venice. The piazza's main attractions are the city's most famous church, San Marco Basilica, and the Doge's Palace, which served as the residence of Venice's rulers for hundreds of years. The square is a popular tourist destination that is surrounded by cafes and vendors. Lido, a 10-kilometer-long sandy island east of the historic center on the lagoon's rim, attracts thousands of beachgoers during the summer months. The Venice Film Festival is one of the city's major annual film events. Venice has faced numerous challenges as a result of its sea-level location and global warming. The Mediterranean town has been regularly flooded by incoming tides over the centuries. From November to February, they cause acqua alta, which causes sea levels to rise up to 1.5 meters and cover many of Venice's famous areas. To provide pedestrians with a path to walk, wooden walkways must be built. Many buildings' foundations have been damaged by seawater, necessitating ongoing repairs. Water seeps into the buildings, destroying the walls and the priceless frescoes. Industries and tourism have steadily reduced ground water levels in Venice, making building foundations unstable. The islands are sinking at an alarming rate of 3 to 4 mm per year. City planners are working on building a series of steel gates that will hopefully prevent seawater from entering the lagoon. title: Venice, Italy 🇮🇹 | Hot Summer Walking Tour 2022 - 4K/60fps HDR
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Venice is one of the world's most beautiful cities. It is made up of over a hundred islands in a lagoon in the northern Adriatic Sea. Venice is a cultural and tourist destination known for its museums, architecture, cityscape, and art world. Only around one-fourth of Venice's 280 000 inhabitants live in the city's historical center. The remainder reside on the mainland. Boats that travel up and down the city's many canals are the primary mode of transportation between the islands. The Canale Grande, which runs through the heart of Venice, is the main waterway. The islands are linked by hundreds of bridges. Motorboats have largely replaced the historic gondolas, which are now only used for sightseeing tours. People either walk or take so-called waterbuses to get around the islands. The Piazza San Marco, also known as Saint Mark's Square, is the heart of Venice. The piazza's main attractions are the city's most famous church, San Marco Basilica, and the Doge's Palace, which served as the residence of Venice's rulers for hundreds of years. The square is a popular tourist destination that is surrounded by cafes and vendors. Lido, a 10-kilometer-long sandy island east of the historic center on the lagoon's rim, attracts thousands of beachgoers during the summer months. The Venice Film Festival is one of the city's major annual film events. Venice has faced numerous challenges as a result of its sea-level location and global warming. The Mediterranean town has been regularly flooded by incoming tides over the centuries. From November to February, they cause acqua alta, which causes sea levels to rise up to 1.5 meters and cover many of Venice's famous areas. To provide pedestrians with a path to walk, wooden walkways must be built. Many buildings' foundations have been damaged by seawater, necessitating ongoing repairs. Water seeps into the buildings, destroying the walls and the priceless frescoes. Industries and tourism have steadily reduced ground water levels in Venice, making building foundations unstable. The islands are sinking at an alarming rate of 3 to 4 mm per year. City planners are working on building a series of steel gates that will hopefully prevent seawater from entering the lagoon. title: Assisi, Italy 🇮🇹 4K Walking Tour — Basilica of St. Francis, Rocca Maggiore & Medieval Streets
description: Welcome to Assisi, the medieval hill town in Umbria where St. Francis was born — and one of the most beautiful places I've filmed in all of Italy. We climb from Piazza Santa Chiara up through narrow stone lanes to the Cathedral of San Rufino, the Roman amphitheater, and the Rocca Maggiore fortress crowning the hilltop, then descend to the magnificent Basilica of St. Francis. It is forever tied to St. Francis (1182–1226), patron saint of Italy and founder of the Franciscan Order, and to St. Clare, who founded the Poor Clares here. The Basilica of St. Francis, begun in 1228 and consecrated in 1253, holds his tomb and some of the greatest fresco cycles in Western art — works by Giotto, Cimabue, Simone Martini, and Pietro Lorenzetti. In 2000 it joined the UNESCO World Heritage List. title: Erice, Sicily Walking Tour - 4K - With Captions!
description: This walking tour of ERICE, SICILY was filmed on Friday June 22nd, 2020 starting at 3:41 PM at the Porta Trapani. The historical center of Erice is on the top of Mount Saint Julian, a strategic center of great importance since ancient times. It was populated by the Elimi people and sought after by the Greeks and the Carthaginians. During the Arab-Norman period it had its major development, but with Trapani's assertion its decline became evident. Like many medieval towns that reinforced their defenses in Norman times, it had a strategic military position. The city center has maintained its medieval installation because there was no expansion in the following eras. title: ALICANTE, Spain 🇪🇸 Pure Mediterranean Summer | 4K Walking Tour
description: Explore Alicante, one of Spain’s most beautiful Mediterranean cities, in this real time 4K walking tour. With its palm lined boulevards, golden beaches, and colorful old town streets, Alicante is a perfect mix of seaside relaxation and Spanish culture. We begin along the Explanada de España, the city’s famous mosaic promenade shaded by palm trees, before heading into the Old Town (El Barrio) with its narrow streets, lively squares, and vibrant atmosphere. The walk continues toward the marina and Postiguet Beach, offering stunning views of the sea and the Santa Bárbara Castle overlooking the city. 📍 Highlights of this walk: – Explanada de España – Palm-lined promenade with mosaic tiles – Old Town (El Barrio) – Narrow alleys, tapas bars & local life – Postiguet Beach – Golden sand & Mediterranean sea views – Alicante Marina – Boats, yachts & coastal breeze – Santa Bárbara Castle views – Historic fortress above the city 📌 About Alicante: Located on Spain’s Costa Blanca, Alicante is known for its warm climate, historic old town, and Mediterranean lifestyle. With a mix of beaches, culture, and Spanish charm, it’s a destination that combines relaxation with authentic city life. 🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Alicante, Spain 📽️ Format: 4K UHD at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no voiceover ☀️ Time: Daytime Would you rather spend your day in Alicante exploring its historic old town or relaxing on the Mediterranean beach? 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: Granada, Spain 🇪🇸 - July 2023 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶90min)
description: 🔴 🔔Subscribe to Tourister ➡️https://bit.ly/3ySvjV2 Join this channel to get access to perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEZ_zB95xT6J8u33-pBF6UA/join Welcome to Granada, a captivating city nestled in the heart of Andalusia, Spain. This enchanting destination is a treasure trove of history, culture, and architectural marvels that will leave you spellbound. At the crown of Granada's splendor stands the majestic Alhambra, a breathtaking palace and fortress complex that boasts intricate Islamic architecture and stunning gardens. A UNESCO World Heritage site, the Alhambra offers a glimpse into Spain's Moorish past, with its intricate tilework, ornate arches, and tranquil courtyards evoking a sense of timeless beauty. Stroll through the labyrinthine streets of the Albayzín, the old Moorish quarter, where whitewashed houses and cobblestone alleys create a picturesque setting. As you explore this historic neighborhood, you'll encounter cozy tea houses, charming plazas, and panoramic viewpoints offering vistas of the Alhambra and the Sierra Nevada mountains. Granada's rich history also extends to the city's vibrant Christian legacy. The impressive Granada Cathedral, a masterpiece of Renaissance architecture, stands as a testament to the city's transformation under Christian rule. Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere of Plaza Nueva, a bustling square where locals and visitors come together to enjoy tapas and drinks. This time-honored tradition of complimentary tapas with drinks allows you to savor a variety of delicious dishes while sipping on refreshing beverages. For a change of pace, venture into the picturesque Sacromonte district, famous for its cave dwellings and flamenco shows. The passionate rhythms of flamenco music and dance will transport you to the soulful heart of Andalusian culture. Granada's location at the foothills of the Sierra Nevada makes it an ideal gateway to outdoor adventures. During the winter months, you can even go skiing in the nearby mountains before returning to the city's warmth and charm. As the day winds down, the city comes alive with a lively nightlife scene. Whether you prefer intimate bars, trendy clubs, or traditional flamenco performances, Granada has something to offer every nocturnal adventurer. Granada's allure lies not only in its historical landmarks but also in the genuine warmth of its people. Embrace the spirit of "duende," a profound and emotional expression deeply embedded in Andalusian culture, and you'll discover the true essence of Granada. A visit to Granada is an unforgettable journey through time, where centuries-old legacies intertwine with contemporary vibrancy, creating an experience that will stay with you forever. ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will remove you completely & immediately ***

title: SEOUL, Gangnam 🇰🇷 Exploring Seoul's Most Iconic District | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Seoul walking tour takes you through Gangnam, one of the most modern and iconic districts in Seoul, South Korea. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this immersive Gangnam city walk captures wide boulevards, neon lights, underground passages, and the vibrant energy of one of Asia’s most famous neighborhoods. I start at the famous “I Love Gangnam” sign, right in the center of the district, before walking along Gangnam-daero, the main street lined with skyscrapers, shops, and constant traffic. The scale of the area is immediately noticeable — wide roads, modern buildings, and a nonstop urban atmosphere. From there, I continue toward Seocho-daero and back along Gangnam-daero, showing different angles of this busy district. At one point, I head underground through the metro station, revealing another side of Gangnam with shopping corridors and pedestrian tunnels connecting the city below street level. Back above ground, I explore streets filled with bars, cafés, and restaurants, where the atmosphere becomes more social and lively. As I continue along Bongeunsa-ro and into smaller back alleys, the area feels more local, with hidden spots and quieter streets. As night falls, Gangnam completely transforms — neon lights turn on, the streets get even busier, and the district shows its full nightlife energy. I finish near the Gangnam metro station, right where everything connects. This Gangnam 4K walking tour captures both the modern cityscape and the nightlife energy of one of Seoul’s most famous districts. 🎥 Perfect for those searching for: Seoul walking tour 4K, Gangnam walking tour, Seoul Gangnam street walk, Gangnam at night, Seoul city walk, Gangnam nightlife walk, Seoul modern district walk, Korea city walk, Gangnam-daero walk, Seoul walking tour no commentary. 🕒 Chapters: 0:00 Starting at "I love Gangnam" Sign 1:12 Gangnam-daero (Main Street) 17:57 Seocho-daero 26:06 Gangnam-daero 33:53 Going underground via the metro station 36:56 Other side of Gangnam-daero 38:33 Streets of Bars & Cafes 56:09 Bongeunsa-ro 1:01:18 Back Alleys 1:23:14 Gangnam at Night 1:31:01 Metro Station at Gangnam 🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Gangnam, Seoul, South Korea 🇰🇷 📽️ Format: 4K Ultra HD at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary 🌆 Time: Daytime into Night 📱✈️ Traveling and need mobile data? title: Chania Crete Greece 🇬🇷 | Virtual Night City Tour around Old Harbour 4K
description: 💎 One Of The Best Cities In The Mediterranean. ▪︎As I stroll around the town of Chania, I admire its remarkable architecture -a magnificent lighthouse in the port, churches and houses in the Old Town, all reminding me of the city's multicultural identity, in fact, I often feel I have entered a time capsule, which takes me back to ancient times, through the Byzantine era and Venetian occupation, to Turkish rule and -tada!- lands me back to today in a modern vibrant town with rich entertainment and cultural offerings. One thing I can tell you about Chania is that it's impossible to pick only a handful of random things to do, whether you are visiting solo, with your friends, with kids or on a romantic getaway. ▪︎The nightlife in Chania is simply spectacular and intense. Whether you are a fan of rock, jazz or dance music in the capital of Chania, you can find a wide variety of atmospheric bars and lounge cafes that stay open till a bit after midnight. Outside the town, there are also a few clubs that stay open until the early hours and play loud music. The most popular bars are found in the old port of Chania or at the backstreets of the Medieval Town. In the famous tourist places in the region, like Platanias and Agia Marina, there are few all-night clubs with loud music. For a more peaceful night out, you can just go for dinner in one of the many seaside taverns in the prefecture of Chania. In these taverns, try the local wine and raki.

title: BERLIN - Germany 🇩🇪 4K Walking Tour | Iphone 15 Pro 📹 Berlin is getting cold and windy 🥶
description: This walking video was recorded in 4k in Berlin, the capital of Germany 🇩🇪 Berlin is the capital and a state of the Federal Republic of Germany. With about 3.7 million inhabitants, the city is the most populous and, with 892 square kilometers, the largest municipality in Germany, as well as the most populous city in the European Union. The city has the third highest population density in Germany with 4108 inhabitants per square kilometer. Nearly 4.7 million inhabitants live in the Berlin agglomeration, and about 6.2 million in the Berlin-Brandenburg capital region. Berlin is considered a world city of culture, politics, media and science. The local universities and research institutions, local sports and museums enjoy an international reputation. The metropolis holds the UNESCO title of City of Design and is one of the continent's most visited centers. Its architecture, festivities and nightlife are world-renowned. After the end of World War II, the city was subject to a four-power status in 1945; East Berlin functioned as the capital of the socialist German Democratic Republic from 1949, while West Berlin was closely aligned with the liberal-democratic Federal Republic. With the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 and German reunification in 1990, the two halves of the city grew together again and Berlin regained its role as the all-German capital. Since 1999, the city has been the seat of the Federal Government, the Federal President, the German Bundestag, the Bundesrat, as well as most federal ministries, numerous federal agencies and embassies. 🙌 Support with a donation! https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/MediaOZ 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: Avignon, France 4K Walking Tour — Palace of the Popes, Pont d'Avignon & Medieval Old Town
description: Avignon walking tour through Place de l'Horloge, the Palace of the Popes, Pont Saint-Bénézet, and Les Halles market — a day walk through the UNESCO-listed "City of the Popes" in Provence, France. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio. One of France's most historically significant medieval cities, Avignon was the seat of the Catholic Church from 1309 to 1377, when seven French popes ruled here instead of Rome. The Palais des Papes is the largest Gothic palace in Europe, and the famous Pont d'Avignon — with only 4 of its original 22 arches remaining — earned the historic centre UNESCO World Heritage status in 1995. Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones. ⭐ Don't miss: Place de l'Horloge at 18:01, the Palace of the Popes at 23:07, Pont Saint-Bénézet at 42:05, and Les Halles at 1:23:49. 📅 Filmed on: Thursday, September 18th, 2025 🌞 Weather: 29°C | 85°F 📍 Location: Avignon, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1_oLp6WjK3xM6gcGq2TYxER83Vzo788w&usp=sharing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro and Map 0:53 Pont Édouard Daladier Viewpoint 6:11 Porte de l'Oulle 6:35 Place Crillon 7:50 Rue Folco de Baroncelli 8:32 Rue Joseph Vernet 11:13 Rue Saint-Agricol 12:14 Church of Saint-Agricol ⭐ 18:01 Place de l'Horloge ⭐ 23:07 Place du Palais 30:13 Cathédrale Notre-Dame des Doms 35:54 Leaving Place du Palais 38:47 Rue Pente Rapide ⭐ 42:05 Pont Saint-Bénézet (Pont d'Avignon) 50:00 Chapelle Saint-Nicolas ⭐ 54:51 Walking the City Ramparts 58:31 Walking back to Place du Palais 1:03:36 Place du Palais 1:05:36 Rue de la Peyrolerie 1:10:18 Place Cloître Saint-Pierre 1:12:47 Place Saint-Pierre 1:14:05 Place Carnot 1:15:19 Rue des Fourbisseurs 1:16:53 Rue du Vieux Sextier 1:19:00 Place Pie 1:21:24 Tour Saint-Jean ⭐ 1:23:49 Les Halles d'Avignon 1:33:30 Rue de la Bonneterie 1:35:04 Rue des Teinturiers 1:37:18 Roue à aubes (water wheel) 1:38:54 Rue des Teinturiers 1:46:25 Old Town Shopping Streets 2:01:15 Rue Galante 2:04:24 Place Saint-Didier 2:08:04 Place des Corps Saints 2:15:30 Square Agricol Perdiguier 2:18:35 Cours Jean Jaurès 2:21:08 Porte de la République 2:21:46 Avignon Centre (Train Station) ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⛪ ABOUT AVIGNON ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ In 1309, Pope Clement V moved the papal court from Rome to Avignon to escape the chaos of the Italian Peninsula. Over the next 68 years, seven French popes ruled Western Christianity from this city. The Palais des Papes was constructed in under 20 years on the rocky outcrop above the Rhône. The Pont Saint-Bénézet, immortalized in the nursery rhyme "Sur le pont d'Avignon," was built in the 12th century as a crossing to Italy and Spain. title: Bruges, Belgium 🇧🇪 - Evening Walk - 2021 - 4K-HDR Walking Tour (▶79min)
description: Join me on a walking tour in Bruges (Belgium), one of Europe's most beautiful cities. During the Middle Ages, Bruges was one of the commercial and cultural metropolis of Europe, and home to famous artists such as Jan van Eyck and Hans Memling. Because of its exceptionally well preserved gothic architecture, the entire city center of Bruges was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2000. The cobble stone streets, majestic city squares, world-class museums and many cultural activities make Bruges a unique travel destination that charms millions of visitors each year. Because of its many canals, Bruges is often referred to as the Venice of the North.

title: BERLIN - Germany 🇩🇪 4K Walking Tour in the City Center
description: This walking video was recorded in 4k in Berlin, the capital of Germany 🇩🇪 Berlin is the capital and a state of the Federal Republic of Germany. With about 3.7 million inhabitants, the city is the most populous and, with 892 square kilometers, the largest municipality in Germany, as well as the most populous city in the European Union. The city has the third highest population density in Germany with 4108 inhabitants per square kilometer. Nearly 4.7 million inhabitants live in the Berlin agglomeration, and about 6.2 million in the Berlin-Brandenburg capital region. Berlin is considered a world city of culture, politics, media and science. The local universities and research institutions, local sports and museums enjoy an international reputation. The metropolis holds the UNESCO title of City of Design and is one of the continent's most visited centers. Its architecture, festivities and nightlife are world-renowned. After the end of World War II, the city was subject to a four-power status in 1945; East Berlin functioned as the capital of the socialist German Democratic Republic from 1949, while West Berlin was closely aligned with the liberal-democratic Federal Republic. With the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 and German reunification in 1990, the two halves of the city grew together again and Berlin regained its role as the all-German capital. Since 1999, the city has been the seat of the Federal Government, the Federal President, the German Bundestag, the Bundesrat, as well as most federal ministries, numerous federal agencies and embassies. 🙌 Support with a donation! https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/MediaOZ 🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: Milan, Italy 🇮🇹 - July 2024 - 4K 60fps HDR Walking Tour
description: Milan, the capital of Lombardy, is Italy's second-largest city and a global fashion and design powerhouse. Renowned for its high-end shopping, vibrant cultural scene, and historical significance, Milan seamlessly blends ancient heritage with modern innovation. Milan boasts a rich history, dating back to its foundation by Celtic Insubres and later flourishing under Roman rule. Key historical landmarks include the Gothic Cathedral, or Duomo di Milano, an architectural masterpiece with intricate spires and statues. The Sforza Castle, a Renaissance fortification, houses several museums and art collections, including works by Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci. Milan is a cultural epicenter, home to world-class museums, theaters, and art galleries. The renowned La Scala Opera House, a beacon of classical music and opera, regularly hosts performances by leading international artists. The city also celebrates contemporary art in venues such as the Museo del Novecento and Fondazione Prada. Often hailed as the fashion capital of the world, Milan hosts biannual fashion weeks, attracting top designers, models, and industry insiders. The Quadrilatero della Moda, an upscale shopping district, features flagship stores of luxury brands like Prada, Gucci, and Versace. Milan's influence extends to design, with the annual Salone del Mobile drawing global attention to its innovative furniture and interior design trends. Milan is Italy's financial hub, hosting the Italian Stock Exchange and headquarters of major banks and multinational corporations. The city excels in various industries, including finance, technology, and manufacturing, driving Italy's economy. In summary, Milan is a vibrant metropolis where history meets modernity, offering a unique blend of cultural richness, economic prowess, and cutting-edge design. Whether exploring its historic landmarks, indulging in luxury shopping, or experiencing its dynamic culinary and cultural scene, Milan captivates residents and visitors alike with its multifaceted charm.

title: Rethymno (Ρέθυμνο), Greece 4K-HDR Walking Tour - 2021 - Tourister Tours
description: Rethymno Greece is a laid-back prefecture located between the regions of Chania and Heraklion. Relatively untouched by international tourists, Rethymno still keeps its traditional charm. The video was recorded 28th of June 2021. On the northern side of Rethymno Crete, there are some cosmopolitan seaside resorts, such as Bali, Adelianos, Kampos, Panormos, and Platanias. They are perfect for your stay, as they have a selection of Rethymno hotels and villas. But, if you seek a laid-back place to stay, a drive around Rethymno will get you to many secluded places, such as Agia Galini and Plakias. The center of activities in Rethymnon is Rethymno Old Town. The architecture of Rethymno Town is strongly influenced by the Venetians, who ruled the island in the past. This picturesque town is full of narrow alleys, elegant mansions, arches, and boasts a beautiful Venetian port. The port of Rethymno is hands down the most popular spot of the town! It is lined with cafeterias and restaurants, while the seafront promenade is perfect for evening strolls. Another vestige of the Venetian occupation is Fortezza, an imposing medieval castle that stands on a hill above the town. The northern and southern coasts of Rethymno are fringed with beautiful beaches, such as Bali, Panormos, Adelianos Kampos, Plakias, and Agia Galini. Rethymno beaches are not the only standouts of the region, though. The inland holds many surprises: traditional villages, impressive gorges, and monasteries, such as Preveli and Arkadi. If you want to introduce yourself to the local culture, a visit to the villages of Rethymno is a must! Rethymno is the getaway you’ve been looking for! ***This Video Vlog is Made to show the city and the environment, if you are present on this video and you don't want to be please contact me or comment on this video and i will make sure that you are not on this video anymore.***

title: Naxos, Greece - Get Lost in Paradise - 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: Naxos, the largest island in the Cyclades, is a picturesque gem in the Aegean Sea known for its rich history, beautiful landscapes, and charming traditional villages. The island is famous for its ancient ruins, including the iconic Portara, a massive marble gate from a never-completed temple of Apollo that stands proudly near the harbor. Naxos has a diverse landscape, from golden sandy beaches such as Agios Prokopios and Plaka to lush, mountainous regions perfect for hiking. Its main town, Naxos Town (Chora), blends modern conveniences with old-world charm, featuring narrow cobblestone streets, whitewashed buildings, and the towering Venetian Kastro. Naxos also boasts fertile lands that produce a variety of local products, such as olives, wine, cheese, and its famous potatoes. The island’s cultural heritage is deeply rooted in ancient Greek mythology; it’s said to be the place where Theseus abandoned Ariadne after slaying the Minotaur, and where Dionysus later found and married her. The island’s mix of history, nature, and culture makes it a popular destination for those seeking both adventure and relaxation in the Greek islands.
